reviews.title: Another Amazing Visit at Silverton
reviews.text: Thirty five years ago my husband and I were married at the Little White Wedding Chapel in Vegas, needless to say Vegas is our jam (4 hour drive!) Our three children have spent their 21st birthdays in Vegas, we have celebrated many things in Vegas...until the last few years. Vegas   has become way too expensive, every little thing that used to set Vegas apart now costs you. BUT THEN...we saw an offer for Silverton and decided to try it, nope it's not on the strip or downtown BUT that's the best part!! Rooms are large and beautifully decorated, parking is free (YES, even valet) their casino is fully stocked with all games...$5 craps and blackjack and all popular slots! Their pool has been completely renovated and is heated and designed for an all day stay poolside. Their restaurants are delicious (Mexican, steakhouse, sushi bar, diner, a REAL Starbucks (order ahead, use points, earn points) and a small type food court. Cocktail servers are friendly and plentiful - yep, free drinks while playing! Paying cash for a drink is totally reasonable and far less than the strip. Check in process is easy and WOW the employees actually behave as if they want to be at work and are genuinely happy to help you! While our last visit was just a couple of weeks ago, one name remains in my mind...Mai at the check in desk was WONDERFUL! Her smile, friendliness and jokester attitude absolutely set our three day visit up for a good time...Silverton did not disappoint.  Thank you again Mai and Silverton, see you soon! **One final tip, catching an Uber to the strip or downtown will run you between $20-30 dollars, with all of the money we save by staying at Silverton it more than pays for the rides.

reviews.title: Professional staff, comfortable room, and a tranquil stay
reviews.text: This hotel was a fantastic place to stay while in town on business. From the moment I entered the lobby, I was warmly welcomed by the hotel staff, and the check-in process went very smoothly. My room was warm, spacious, and very comfortable (the bed was the perfect balance between soft and not too squishy). I loved that the room had complimentary K-cups available; they came in handy when I had to wake up early for meetings. I especially appreciated that this hotel isn't on the Strip, so I got to avoid the chaos and have a more tranquil stay.

reviews.title: Wonderful Experience at the Silverton Hotel and Casino.
reviews.text: We had a fantastic experience at the Silverton Hotel and Casino.  We stayed in a Suite, which was absolutely great, spacious, clean and very comfortable. We had a beautiful view of the pool and hot tub. Special thanks to Casino Host Fe'adolphus Curt for helping with this stay. Check in was swift and Mie, as well as Belinda, both Registration staff, placed us in a Suite, and our luggage soon followed. The suite was very much like three separate rooms between the bedroom, living area and breakfast nook, and the bathroom, complete with separate large shower area, a huge bathtub, and his and her bathroom sinks. Having this much space definitely helps a couple to relax. Two large screen television sets were mounted on the walls in the bedroom and living room.Of course the casino action was fun, and we did well. We are both player's club members, and there are a lot of perks that come along with that. We also visited the Su' Casa, and Sun dance Restaurants.  Needless to say the food and service was quite good.We have been visiting the Silverton often, mainly because it is off the strip, and not as hectic as strip locations. I use a walking cane, and accommodations for senior citizens we find refreshing. However, there are quite a handful of younger couples who stay there too, most likely because of the BassPro Shop entrance and the largest fish aquarium is located in the Casino, and there are mermaids that put on a nice show for little ones.Mike and Ester

reviews.title: Great atmosphere, Great staff & fun gambling!
reviews.text: The Silverton is our go to location when in Las Vegas. We love the lodge atmosphere, food & drink options & great staff! The rooms have been recently renovated and they are awesome. The king bed was super comfortable and we enjoyed Starbucks coffee each morning from the in-room provided  K-cup machine, and REAL coffee cups! I realize that coffee may not be a real important point to some, but when it is your 1st NEEDED ritual of the day, well you get the point, LOL. The rooms look great with that western lodge theme throughout. The staff at the Silverton have always made our stays much more enjoyable. We have always been treated with a smile and great service. We even had a casino host stop in to say hi and ask if we needed anything while the wife and I were playing video poker and enjoying some specialty cocktails at the Shady Grove Lounge. On our most recent trip we even took some time to relax in the newly renovate pool area. Jumped in the jacuzzi and pool, picked up a burger and fries from Johnny Rockets (located inside the casino) and enjoyed a little wine-down time by the fire pit. Was neat to see the aquarium decked out for Halloween and we always enjoy a stroll through the attached Bass Pro Shop to see what we didn't know we needed. We always enjoy our stays at the Silverton!

reviews.title: A Friendly Place, The Silverton Casino and Hotel.
reviews.text: My wife and I were stranded, looking for a place to stay for the night and the first thing that came to mind was the Silverton Casino and Hotel.  I never stayed there before, but I frequented their establishment many times.  When I phoned their reservations desk, I was greeted by a female by the name of Christie.  She was so gracious and showed a great deal of concern with our dilemma.  After finding out that we were from Hawaii our conversation became more cordial.  She said she lived in Hawaii too.  She set us up with a room and to our surprise it was immaculate and very elegant looking.  Everything you could ever want in a room was provided, neat, clean and in it's right place.  The next day we went to eat at the cafe and the food was great.  Next, we were sitting in the casino and the security guard walked up and talked to us.  His name was Ron and he too was from Hawaii.  The atmosphere at Silverton is like no other, with the large aquarium, the sporting good store and the friendly people at the casino.  I also like the numerous restaurants, to which to pick from.  All in all I would rate Silverton Casino a go to place, and if you remember I said I never stayed there before, well I'm going to make it a point to stay there whenever I'm in Vegas.  I already told my friends about the Silverton and advised them that they should try it.  Oh, one more thing, the shuttle driver was also from Hawaii, go figure, if they work there, it must be a great place to stay.

reviews.title: A Place that Feels Like Home
reviews.text: We couldn't have had a better stay. Our casino host, Curt, and all of the staff at Silverton are to be commended for their hospitality and welcoming atmosphere. We felt at home.Took a little while to get the lay of the land, but once we did it wasn't bad getting around at all. I actually made it to the far end of the casino the last night we were there and saw how big the place REALLY is! Everyone from the hotel front desk to the room attendants to the valet guys were just so accommodating and easy to work with. Then add in the casino staff and the cage folks and it made for a fun time.We normally like to make it down to Magnolia's at the 4-Queens. But with Sundance, we didn't miss it! That place has such good food and huge portions! Their breakfasts were wonderful. And the dinner we had was awesome. (the corn chowder is to die for!!!). Prices were very reasonable.Mi Casa was perfect for us our first night. We wanted something different and we got it there. The people were very friendly and the food was outstanding. It was a great culinary start to our week!  Prices were comparable to other places we've been Twin Creeks, what can I say about that place? The ambiance was excellent. The servers were amazing. And the food? Well, it pains me to say it but that was the best ribeye I've ever had. The sides were plentiful and tasted wonderful. We have found a new home at Silverton.

reviews.title: Staycation at the Silverton
reviews.text: I recently spent a few days at the Silverton Casino with my adult son and daughter for a quick staycation, and we had an awesome experience. From check-in to check-out, everything went smoothly and we felt totally relaxed the whole time. Belinda at the front desk helped us during check-out and couldn’t have been nicer. She asked how our stay was, chatted with us a bit, and sent us off with a genuine smile. It’s those little moments that really stick with you.The hotel itself was spotless, and our room was super comfortable. The beds were cozy, and anytime we ordered room service, it came quickly and the staff was always friendly. We also tried a few of the restaurants on-site every one of them had great food and really solid service.If you’re after a clean, low-key place to stay that’s still close to the action, Silverton is a great option. The casino was well-kept, the pool and hot tub area were perfect for relaxing, and the overall vibe was chill and welcoming. We’ll definitely be coming back again.

reviews.title: Wonderful Experience
reviews.text: The rooms were clean and welcoming. The staff was attentive and friendly. We also enjoyed the pool. Everything was easy and accommodating. I would stay there again!

reviews.title: Staycation
reviews.text: The staff was top notch, the room was clean and comfortable, we loved the Western theme, and the food was the best! We're locals, we had a weekend staycation at the Silverton, and can't wait to do it again!

reviews.title: Get a way
reviews.text: Couldn't ask for a better resort, seven restaurants, Bass pro, slots and table games,  exercise room, swimmin' hole, and the nicest staff. Off the strip, but close enough . This was my second visit this year.

reviews.title: Perfect experience
reviews.text: A beautiful property, with outstanding personal . We had the best stay, nothing could have been better. We can't wait to come back. Hopefully next time we can stay a little longer. The only thing that could be better would be winning lots of Money.

reviews.title: Family-Friendly Gem Off the Strip
reviews.text: This is a very accommodating, family-friendly hotel with plenty of options and great value—especially for Las Vegas. Every staff member we interacted with was genuinely helpful and welcoming. Not a single unpleasant encounter, which is rare anywhere, let alone Vegas.The rooms were well-appointed and comfortable, offering solid value for the price. The recently renovated pool was a great way to relax and pass a couple of hours.Highly recommend this hotel for both families and couples looking for a quieter, more relaxed Vegas experience. We’re already looking forward to coming back.

reviews.title: We love the Silverton Hotel and Casino!!
reviews.text: We enjoyed our room, which was very comfortable.  We found the a staff to be very friendly, from the hotel desk to the pool, bars, restaurants and the casino.  We ate at four of the restaurants and were pleased with all four.  We will definitely stay again.

reviews.title: Best week in Las Vegas!
reviews.text: Hubby and I went to Vegas to celebrate my retirement, we stayed at Silverton casino , we had a great time, it’s a nice place the staff is really friendly, food is delicious waking up to have some Starbucks coffee everyday wonderful!! no rush or noise the beds are so clean and comfortable. We did not go to the pool area but will go next time.Thank you Silverton we will definitely come back soon. 💞

reviews.title: Nice stay
reviews.text: Very nice stay, clean comfortable room. Nice dining options at casino. Shopped at the Bass Pro shop attached to casino. Casino floor was very clean. Pool area was very nice, we didn't sit in the sun but walked around pool, very nice. Will return.

reviews.title: Couldn't ask for more
reviews.text: The best off the strip experience. Great, clean pool, attentive staff, easy in and out. Rooms are always super clean and ready. No long elevator rides up 20 stories. Covered self park with lots of handicap spots. Free gaming and food for loyalty customers

reviews.title: MEMORABLE
reviews.text: Everyone excels making you welcomed. The newly remodeled rooms are amazing and comfortable. The casino floor is welcoming and you will never have the overcrowded strip experience. The variety of restaurants give plenty of choices for a good meal. Great value.

reviews.title: Absolutely wounderful
reviews.text: Enjoyed everything about my stay friendly service I even won a jack pot it was a great experience. it was very clean and our room was perfect. we will be going back real soon. the swimming area is to die for. You will not find a better plae to stay trustme.

reviews.title: Amazed! My favorite!
reviews.text: I hate to say this because I don’t want to be waitlist to stay but Silverton is my favorite!  Clean, smells amazing, no over crowded pools,Good dining ( not way over priced) and great gaming floor selection. I have stayed in many places in Vegas.

reviews.title: Amazing!!!!!
reviews.text: The greetings from help desk at check in is amazing the Uncle that greeted was very welcoming and offered chips for winery and the pool area, which was amazing. Rooms are amazing the bed is soft and the pillows are soft! Silverton provides numbers of pillow on one bed. Eating at Sundance as amazing loved our waitress Faith she was amazing. We got her twice. Overall the workers there are very welcoming. Love how the hotel staff are so welcoming and smiling. This hotel is very family oriented especially for kids.

reviews.title: Bait and Switch
reviews.text: I find the number of five star reviews for this place highly suspect, and you should too. Tried to check in yesterday on an offer they emailed to me and was immediately given the bait and switch. I politely showed them my email which clearly stated  the offer and another email with my confirmation.  Another lady came out and both of them proceeded to very rudely shut me down and said the offer had “changed.”  My husband and I had stayed there on a very similar offer he received with no problems, so we knew what we were doing, but suddenly here it was my turn and they could not have been more rude. Well, I am sure they don’t care, but they lost a couple of good customers, as I was so offended that I will never step foot in there again.  The casino smells like bad carpet fresh anyway and there’s no vibe to speak of.  Keep driving and go to Southpoint, where they know the meaning of good customer service.

reviews.title: Had a great time.
reviews.text: Rooms were excellent and clean. The food and the quantity in the restaurants was excellent.Best part was the entertainment, such as the huge aquarium and the mermaids that were very entertaining and communicated with the children. Loved shopping at the pro bass shop.

reviews.title: Vacation experience that is worth the stay.
reviews.text: The hotel rooms very nice, well furnished, clean and comfortable.  One of the best I stayed at.  Also, the staff were friendly, nice and attentive to any needs .  Room service was easy to use and the food arrived timely and was a great meal.  The pool, fitness center and aquarium makes for a great stay.

reviews.title: Silverton is pure rustic gold
reviews.text: Silverton Lodge the hidden jewel in plain sight, easy on easy off the highway. If you must uber into the strip. However everything you need for Vegas fun is here. The newly refreshed rooms fantastic rustic feel my wife loves the bed, pillows and shower. The food choices are excellent too many to list. The customer service from front desk, bartenders to casino floor off the hook delightful. The Circa sports-book and its personnel is customer delight. The new swimming hole with a massive giant humongous enormous beautiful tv screen is pure oasis magic while splashing and sipping beverages in and around the pool.

reviews.title: A great place to stay off the strip
reviews.text: The rooms are excellent and the staff from registration and through out the casino lodge are very courteous and helpful. We've been staying at Silverton for many years and the upgrade of the rooms last year has made this hotel a truly great place to stay. We like it much more than the huge hotels on the strip.

reviews.title: Best place in LV!
reviews.text: The staff is accommodating and so friendly.   The rooms are lovely, western theme but classy.  The bed was great.  The pool is wonderful.  The lounges are cushioned and very comfortable.  The pool is heated and very relaxing.  The pool staff is very responsive and the food is great.  The food is plentiful in the restaurants and reasonable.  I tell all my friends that this is the place to stay in LV.

reviews.title: Vegas Without The Hefty Price Tag
reviews.text: We stayed here just to try it out as we have family that comes in to town a lot and they like staying close to our home. Check in was nice and easy, the front desk person was warm and very knowledgeable of what was going on within the hotel that night and our options around the hotel. They recently renovated the rooms and they’re absolutely gorgeous. It felt like you were staying at a nice strip hotel, but for a fraction of the price. We didn’t swim, but the pool area looked really nice as well. I would definitely recommend this hotel if you’re looking for a nice place to stay, close to the freeway to get to areas like the strip or downtown, and at a good value!

reviews.title: A great place to stay
reviews.text: The Silverton is a clean and friendly hotel and casino. The staff is attentive and courteous. It’s a great off strip option for anyone who would enjoy a more personal  experience. At check in I was given multiple room optionsBeverage service on the casino floor was in glass not plastic. I had an issue with my shower that was resolved in short order. I will definitely be staying here again

reviews.title: Spring trip to Silverton
reviews.text: We had a fantastic time at the Silverton , the pool is amazing , the rooms were so clean, the staff are so helpful and friendly. It felt like Vegas back when Vegas cared for their customers . We had a blast in the casino and enjoyed shopping at Bass Pro. Not to mention how great the restaurants were. We will definitely be back!!

reviews.title: Great Lodge Experience!!!
reviews.text: Enjoyed the backyard Oasis!!! I feel this Resort has a great Lodge theme and its beautifully layed out.  This is much better location to stay than on the Strip or Downtown, in my opinion.  Looking forward to my next month trip.  Ask for Pool view rooms.

reviews.title: Love the Newly Renovated Silverton
reviews.text: Love the newly renovated rooms upgraded bathrooms and comfortable beds. No more old carpet smell, but maintained the family-friendly atmosphere. The giant screen overlooking the pool added a very nice touch. We will be back and definitely recommend this place to family and friends

reviews.title: Most Enjoyable Place
reviews.text: Most gracious experience every employee I had contact with ,rather the front desk, the house keeping staff  or the casino host all made my experience exceptional , Even the cleanliness of the hotel ( Impressive) The Choice and restaurant selection  was a bonus, the food from SUndance, Mi Casa Grill, Su Casa Sushi Bar all was great and want to thank you for making my experience exceptional.

reviews.title: What a great and fun place to be in Vegas, can’t say enough, rooms are great.Our family loves this place, friendly staff
reviews.text: What a great and fun place to be in Vegas, can’t say enough, rooms are great.Our family loves this place, friendly staff

reviews.title: Great Spring Break trip
reviews.text: This was are first time visiting and staying at the Silverton.  We had a great time.  The staff was friendly and helpful.  Special thanks to the excellent valet service from Andres and Allen.  Also Brendon who we met in the the pool area was very kind.  We had dinner twice at Mi Casa and breakfast twice at Sundance.  We enjoyed all of our meals.  We decided to try the Silverton because it was near the mountain bike trails at Blue Diamond.  It only took us about 20 minutes to get to the trailhead.  Our favorite area was the pool.  It was so nice and new.  We preferred staying versus staying on the strip.

reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.text: Our standard king room was perfect. Beautiful, clean and new. We loved staying here so much. The wine tasting while watching the fish swim by was so much fun. The pool area and casino were very nice. There is a Starbucks which we visited every morning within the resort. There are so many restaurants and shopping areas within minutes. The strip was only a few minutes away and also the airport. I can’t wait to return!

reviews.title: Great place we stayed in Vegas
reviews.text: The room was super spacious and beautifully decorated. The bed was very comfortable and I slept soundly all night.   I enjoyed the bar at the casino and the hot tub. The service was excellent. Everyone was so nice and I even made some new friends at the pool.

reviews.title: Awesome weekend
reviews.text: Entire staff were super friendly.  Nice clean rooms with great beds. casino is not very Smokey. Pool & jacuzzi are newly remolded and awesome.  Highly suggest the steak house and cafe is excellent as well. We really enjoyed our stay and looking forward to coming back!!!

reviews.title: Great place to stay!
reviews.text: The bed and linen were exceptional.  The room was clean and comfortable and quiet.  The pool water is warm.  You can order drinks and food at the poolside.  There is a hot tub also.  All the restirants are great.  I will definitely stay here again.  Staff is friendly and helpful.

reviews.title: Recent stay
reviews.text: First time staying at the Silverton. It is a Great location. We had a great time! It was a wonderful experience. Super clean hotel. Will definitely be coming back again. It was great parking as well a lot of places near by Great customer service

reviews.title: Clean, Friendly, Great Food
reviews.text: Thank you for the great experience, the food at the restaurants was all fantastic. The pool area and dining at the pool is first class. Clean, friendly and first class all around. I will definitely be visiting again. Tremendous value and 10/10 experience

reviews.title: Springtime at the Silverton.
reviews.text: The newly remodeled Silverton Casino Lodge was well appointed and comfortable. The large aquarium at the entrance was a beautiful surprise. They provided educational sessions and the occasional mermaid. Every staff member we encountered was very friendly and helpful. The pool area was inviting and very relaxing. I would highly recommend a stay at The Silverton.

reviews.title: What an awesome hotel
reviews.text: I love this property, the staff is extremely friendly and recognaized me for my Brirthday.  It starts with the arrival experience at valet to the front desk, F&B, and Casino. The rooms are clean and smoke free. The recent renovation was done well.  Can't wait to return soon!

reviews.title: My most favourite place to stay!!!
reviews.text: My Husband and I love the Silverton Hotel.  We have stayed here every spring and fall for 12 years.  It is always clean and has the most friendly staff. …  And the food at my Sundance Grill. .. never disappoints.  Psssss .. the pool rocks!!Thank you .. see you soon!!!!

reviews.title: Awesome Experience
reviews.text: Excellent resort. The place is super nice and very clean. Staff was very friendly and helpful.  I would definitely stay there again!  The front desk staff was very accommodating and helpful when I need to make a change to my stay. Thank you so much!

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: I enjoy everything Silverton has to offer, it’s an awesome place. The rooms are great, the restaurants are great, and the new pool and hot tub was heavenly. I love the aquarium and the mermaids. Having Bass Pro Shop next door is a shopping pleasure.

reviews.title: Hidden Gem in Vegas
reviews.text: I've been staying at the Silverton Casino Lodge for the past 6 months and love it!  Why?  As a world traveler, I like to have certain "must haves" and like to haves in a hotel I stay at.  Here you!  Excellent staff members throughout the hotel and casino!  Excellent retention from my standpoint as I see the same team each trip.  There is not enough room to tell all of the good but let's break it down in pieces.  Food.  Excellent and multiple choices from Chinese, Mexican up to a high end Steakhouse, Twin Creeks.  Room types.  Excellent options and NO smoking in the hotel areas.  Casino, all of the table games you want to play and a huge selection of slots! POOL....did you want to talk POOL?  A newly renovated pool that is not only beautiful, but has a bar, restaurant and giant tvs to watch you favorite sport while soaking up some rays!

reviews.title: Beyond my expectations
reviews.text: The promptness of the staff  from checkin to check out was amazing and their attentive service was beyond my expectations.  Very clean hotel and many amenities the gym was great and located perfectly where I prefer by the pool. Definitely will return.

reviews.title: Highly recommended
reviews.text: They have the best customer service..thanks to Lori Mei and the rest of the team..three times I've been here and always have such a wonderful stay..this place is so clean and all staff are very nice and courteous...will probably be back next month..again thank you Silverton

reviews.title: Feels like a village
reviews.text: The room was very comfortable. The bedding was luxurious. The hotel is small enough to feel like a village but big enough to have 5 restaurants, lots of gaming, live music. and very friendly staff. Loved the in-room dining. We enjoyed the huge fish tank and shopping at Bass Pro.

reviews.title: We love staying at the Silverton hotel Casino.
reviews.text: We love staying at the Silverton Hotel Casino. The hotel rooms are beautiful! The beds have always been the comfiest. We love the size of the casino, and all the restaurants are delicious. The remodel of the pool area is very modern. We also love that the Bass Pro Shop is right there. 😊

reviews.title: A must stay
reviews.text: Silverton is a great casino to gamble at with new clean tables and fun dealers. The hotel has huge rooms with lots of amenities and smells great day and night. The rooms are nice and quiet as well. Overall is an excellent stay, will be coming here every time!

reviews.title: The best trip ever
reviews.text: The hotel luxury suite was the best I’ve stayed in and the room service and food was great. Whenever I get a chance again I will definitely come back. My wife and kid enjoyed the trip as well they love the room services and couldn’t get enough of the mermaids..

reviews.title: Absolutely Loved The Silverton Lodge
reviews.text: We absolutely loved our stay at the Silverton Lodge.  The staff was exceptional and treated us with such kindness.  The room was clean and decorated beautifully.  The pool area was an absolute WOW factor and was so relaxing by the gas fire pits.  It felt like we were at a resort on one of the islands.  The staff in the restaurants were very friendly and the service was very quick.  We will absolutely stay at the Silverton Lodge again!  It was an awesome experience off the strip!

reviews.title: So much fun!
reviews.text: I have been coming to Silverton for years!  It is always a fun and happy time.  I feel comfortable when I stay and play and it is so much better than staying on the expensive Strip.  It is a casino for regular people who want to unwind.  The food is always good and does not break the bank.  The newly remodeled rooms are very nice and roomy.  Every staff member from casino hosts to the front desk (and bartenders and waitresses) are friendly and helpful!  The mermaid themed fish tank is mesmerizing to watch for hours.  My husband agrees with all of this and for someone who would rather be fishing in Wyoming than going to Vegas that says a lot!

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Everything about the place is amazing! From arrival to departure,  this place is the absolute best! The staff is extremely friendly and helpful.  The gaming floor is exceptionally clean and all of the dealers are super friendly.  All of the restaurants are delicious and they have a little of everything you could be craving.  The rooms are beautifully decorated and spacious.  The pool area is very inviting and they have plenty of seating.  I know there are so many options in Vegas but I highly recommend giving Silverton a look. You will not regret  it!

reviews.title: Excellent choice
reviews.text: Stayed at Silverton during my daughter's Volleyball tournament and we loved it. The beds are super comfortable, rooms are very nice and clean. Great food options from Twin Creeks Steakhouse or WuHu Noodle was fabulous.  My favorite part, when sitting at the bar I love how attentive the bartenders are.  Definitely going back...

reviews.title: Wonderful place
reviews.text: The rooms are very very comfortable.And staff was amazing. I felt like i was back home at my local casino.Casino had all the games I like to play.Inwas the for the China new year the show with the drag7was pretty awesome. I never experienced that before.

reviews.title: BEST OFF STRIP RESORT
reviews.text: My favorite spot to stay in all of Vegas! From the places to eat and drink to the comfy quiet rooms I love staying here. You can't beat their $2.50 modelo, and pacifico beer specials. The pool is open year round and heated in the winter season and parking is free!

reviews.title: Hidden GEM in Vegas
reviews.text: Love coming here, as we come to Vegas frequently from Canada we discovered the silverton & have visited a few times now..we have stayed on 2 occasions and had a great time, we have brought friends  with no worries about disappointment, which is saying quite a bit. Great service friendly staff and good value❣️

reviews.title: Highly recommend!
reviews.text: We loved the decor of the Lodge room and Dining room. Their interior designer is brilliant! Extremely comfortable beds and lots of pillows! It was so quiet, restful, and close to the airport.  I appreciated the comfortable chair, and the really neat closet that lit up inside when opened! From the minute we pulled up and went to registration we felt welcomed and at home. Great food at the dining room.

reviews.title: Five star at Silverton
reviews.text: Staying at Silverton was great.  ALL Silverton staff were polite and very helpful.  Room was very very nice and smells great.  Just be aware that you need to get out of the hotel building to get to the wonderful Fitness Center. Gift shop was great too. And the staff there were nice.

reviews.title: Fun
reviews.text: Great service, fun environment. The room is fantastic. Very convenient. They take care of their player's and members. Checking in if fast and easy. Great food. Easy access to the strip and other entertainment platforms. My wife and I appreciate all their services.

reviews.title: The Silverton is a wonderful place to stay!
reviews.text: We loved staying at the Silverton. Plenty of great dining is available on the property. All of the employees are polite and courteous. The entire facility is very clean and well maintained. The airport shuttle service was superb. There is an atmosphere of fun and freshness throughout the casino. They are well staffed and very customer service oriented! I was so happy to be able to play at a craps table with a $5 minimum because I have been unable to find any craps tables in Las Vegas with a minimum of Les than $10. The discounted room  rate for military was greatly appreciated! We will definitely always stay at the Silverton every time that we stay in Las Vegas!

reviews.title: silverton hotel casino great choice for off the strip vacationing
reviews.text: great all around casino restaurant hotel pool family friendly resort satisfied with everything every time we go either with just me and my wife or with family and friends i always reccomend  silverton casino hotel to everyone i know definite great choice no matter what

reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: I am a Las Vegas local and it was my first time staying here. Obsessed with the room decor. I’m a country girl so I really enjoyed all the western touches.  Will definitely be staying here again. All the staff was so friendly.  We had dinner at Mexican restaurant which was also sooo good.

reviews.title: Great value and service!!!
reviews.text: Silverton Casino and Lodge is just fantastic!  I went for a fun getaway and was happily satisfied. The newly renovated rooms are gorgeous and cool!  A stylish , western theme that is both elegant and comfortable. The staff is friendly and professional. Great value for the price!

reviews.title: Perfect choice as a home for a Las Vegas adventure
reviews.text: We celebrated our 37th Anniversary with a trip to Las Vegas. First time for my wife. I had been numerous times with a previous job. Knew we wanted to be off the Strip, and stumbled upon this gem. It really was an oasis on our special trip. We always looked forward to returning after our day adventures. The rooms were very nice, comfortable bed, and plenty of space. The Swimming Hole was part of our morning routine with a Hot Tub visit each morning. Took a lesson at the casino on how to play Craps. So fun!  Restaurants were fun to choose from. The Aquarium and mermaids brought some fun energy. It truly made our Las Vegas experience one my wife is ready to repeat. Would have loved to stay longer. We will be back and our next adventure will be based out of the Silverton again, with more time planned to just enjoy the Lodge!

reviews.title: SILVERTON  IS UNBEATABLE
reviews.text: Great place great service.  Clean place in and outside of silverton. Everything  in working order. Easy checkin and check outBest  timme to gample eary morningRestaurant s clean and affordable  Love Twin Creeks.      The Tomahawk steak is to die for. Cant say one bad thing about the Silverton  friendly staff

reviews.title: Great new years 2025
reviews.text: Great staff and everyone is so kind and friendly thank you silverton my mom was so happy.   We had a blast and enjoyed every second of it.  I won some money food was great and our room was so nice. Can’t wait to go back. Thank you again for everything Luis

reviews.title: Always a fun experience!
reviews.text: My Wife and I have traveled globally for decades and the Silverton always gives us a 5 star experience. The staff is exceptional, the food is fantastic, the rooms are beautiful and quiet. The daily mermaid in the massive fish tank is a sight to behold and you simply must experience the wonderfful and HUGE Bass pro store...amazing! Try the Silverton you will not be disapointed.

reviews.title: Would Return!
reviews.text: This was a last-minute, emergency booking. When we showed up the first night, there were no rooms available, but we got lucky on our second night and I was able to make a booking online (not from their website). It was cheaper than nearby hotels, and offered a lot more! The room was large and comfortable, but a bit dark. The TV also stopped working properly the following morning. The casino downstairs was also large, casual, and fun. I signed up for the casino's rewards card and got 50% off my breakfast the next day! The restaurant closest to the hotel room entrance was decently priced and offered quick service. The shop in the casino was also on the cheaper side (ex: $2.50 for a soda instead of the $5+ on the strip!)The pool area was lovely - if I had more time, I would have loved to actually use the heated pool! I saw several people enjoying it. I did get a chance to sit near the fire pit, which was so nice on a chilly evening. They do have a large aquarium where we saw the "mermaids" perform a couple of times during our stay, and we even wandered around the Bass Pro Shop. It's off-strip, so there aren't any good views of touristy areas, unfortunately. We didn't use this service, but they do offer a shuttle to the airport (which is only about 10 minutes away). You need to book 24 hours in advance though. Check-in and check-out was fast and easy. Free self-parking was right next to the casino.

reviews.title: A casino committed to a great time. You won’t regret your time sent here.
reviews.text: Skip the strip! Silverton is the best of Las Vegas fun, great associates, friendly local atmosphere, They have created a very safe and beautiful Casino Hotel, and the new pool area is unbeatable for events or leisure. We travel from Minnesota several times a year just to stay at Silverton. The best place to go in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Great get away
reviews.text: It started with a simple e-mail asking if they had any promos for New Years.  A casino host named David  Connors e-mailed me back and called me. After a brief talk I had 4 nights free and $100.00 playing money to use at any game . They just did a remodel and the rooms are awesome. I I enclosed a picture of the TV that they had at the pool as part of the remodel . You can tell how a place is running by the workers attitude towards the customer.  Everyone that I came across whether at the bar or the 3 card table ( my favorite to play) or management had a great friendly attitude and made sure everything was was going great for your vacation.  3 things that I enjoy here are for a break there is the condo size aquarium where families took there kids , The Bass Pro shop and The Cracker Barrell across the parking lot .  After going here I would say stay off the Strip , Relax , and kickback here rather than dealing with the crowds and lines

reviews.title: First time in Silverton casino
reviews.text: The hotel was really nice I have a fridge and a coffee included and that was nice because not even in the strip of Vegas the casinos offer you that nice complementary coffe is just great now the 🏊 pool was open and the jacuzzi as well water nice and warm in winter my son love it

reviews.title: Great Place to Stay
reviews.text: The hotel was newly renovated. It was clean, safe and comfortable. The people there were very friendly and helpful. The hotel had security which made us feel safe. We ate at the Sundance Cafe where service and employees there were very accommodating. The food was excellent, and portions were adequate. The front desk people who check you in are very helpful and friendly. They answered all the questions we had.  The hotel was off the strip, where we generally stayed, and quiet, a relief.   Excellent place to stay ...we'll be back

reviews.title: Perfect stay at Silverton
reviews.text: First time staying at Silverton and won't be the last.  Just a few miles South of strip the cabin themed rooms are spacious,  clean, extremely comfortable beds with tons of pillows! Great selection of restaurants and paying slots. Madison at front desk took a few extra minutes to welcome us first timers and happily answered all our first timer questions. Can't wait to go back,  oh and even though we didn't take advantage of the outdoor heated pool, others were enjoying it!

reviews.title: Excellent hotel and casino
reviews.text: This was the best experience i have had. Wonderful staff and excellent service. From room service to cocktails front desk and much more. Room was beautiful and food excellent. Will go again soon. Casino had lots of machines to choose. Bass pro shop excellent even has mermaids. You will not be disappointed .

reviews.title: Cozy & Comfortable stay
reviews.text: We were greeted by happy, positive employees at the check-in desk.  The Lodge/Casino has a warm and comfortable cozy feeling.  The rooms were equally as comfortable and nicely decorated.  We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and look forward to returning.

reviews.title: Great time and lots of fun!
reviews.text: Best time we had all year. We did the wine tasting and had a large soft pretzel  that was perfect! The rooms were beautiful and we had every need taken care of. We sat out side by the pool and watched the  basket ball game on the huge tv. After watch the mermaids swimming we played on the slots ,that was fun winning some back. We sat at the bar and met some other people and talked about how good the food was here at the Silverton  so many varieties we love the Mexican food and my spouse gets sushi at the same table .Perfect for us both.

reviews.text: We rented two rooms. Had a wonderful three night stay. We had two little ones with us. The staff here is amazingly friendly! Everyone says hello and is very helpful. Rooms are clean and plenty big enough. We had a family dinner at Mi Casa. The food is very good and the service is excellent. Will definitely stay here again.

reviews.text: From the start our visit was great . Valet service was outstandind . Thumbs up to all the Guys out front . Bell hop sevice was fast friendly . Front Desk personnal very friendly an d makes you feel very welcome . have a good laugh with Miss Gem shews great . reviews.text: Our host was fantastic and got us a great room it was well stocked super clean and the tub was fantastic!  The restraints were all very good and the people were so friendly. reviews.title: Great hotel and casino

reviews.title: Wonderful Spot in Las Vegas.
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our time at the Silverton Casino Lodge and Hotel. The room renovations are top notch, the staff very helpful and kind and most of all, quite welcoming. We will definitely come back here. Another plus is that their parking is free and they have all the games/machines you could want. In addition, the beds were so fluffy and comfortable, and the Bananas  Foster French toast for breakfast was a real winner!

reviews.title: ADA rooms are sub-par
reviews.text: Our experience was unique to our room and not an overall opinion of the lodge. At first glance, I thought the room was nice. We were placed in an ADA Room because they were booked and that was all that was available to accommodate us in a double. We have stayed in other ADA rooms and thought it would be ok since I have a pain issue and can use the bars to get in and out of the shower and the extra space for wheelchair access is great. The first night, we noticed that both beds were  very low to the floor and more importantly on a slant toward the middle of the room. Our daughter's bed was the worst. I slept in it on the second night and was at a severe slant but it was so late, we were in our pajamas, tired, etc., and didn't want to disrupt the entire room by moving or having furniture rearranged so I didn't call about it until the morning. Maintenance staff came immediately and I had already identified that the bed was completely out of the frame on one side. I asked them to check both beds for that issue. That evening, it was better. The next night, it came out of the frame again when I swung my legs over the side to get up. Out of 4 nights, I had one decent night of sleep. The other issue was that they installed a tub in the ADA bathroom with very high sides (the height of my knees and I'm 5'8"). I have low back and hip issues so getting in and out was difficult, even with the bars to hold onto. There is also an immovable bench installed at the back of the tub so the standing area was about 2' x 2'. Lastly, the TV is equipped with a narrator for the blind, and I couldn't figure out how to disable it. Watching TV and a movie was a new experience. These are items that I have not experienced in other ADA rooms. I understand that they are attempting to handle all types of disabilities, however, they missed the mark on so much and even caused my pain syndrome to flare because of the bed and shower issues.  My mother stayed in a different room (non-ADA) with comfy beds and a spacious walk-in shower. I will not stay in their ADA room again. I may give them a try in a different room.

reviews.title: Newly Renovated Hotel
reviews.text: This is my first stay at Silverton Casino & Hotel. It's not as convenient to staying on the strip, further away from downtown Las Vegas, but a lot closer to the Rental Car Center than McCarran International Airport. I'm fortunate to get industry rates and always take advantage of the fruits of my labor. Prior to this trip, I checked for available dates and for certain nights on one of the weekends in November which was perfect for my plans! Silverton is also affiliated with Circa. The hotel does charge a $38.41 daily resort fee which includes WiFi, Phone calls, Swimming Pool and other amenities. Fitness Center is newly renovated offering state-of-the-art Life Fitness Machine equipment and several cardio machines. There is also a LF Cable Motion Dual Adjustable Pulley that is super multifunctional. Fitness Center is open 24 hours."The Swimmin' Hole," is a new pool deck, open daily from 9am - 9pm. You can still dive into the warm, inviting waters of their heated pool and hot tub. The pool is kept at a cozy 86 degrees! No food & beverage service is currently available at the moment.You can watch Football on a 32-foot screen at The Swimmin' Hole. You can also watch most games at Circa Sports, Mermaid Lounge or Shady Grove Lounge.Self-Parking Garage and Valet also available. The room I booked was a Refined Lodge King Room. Upon check in, the front desk gal offered me a handful of Wine Tasting chips from 5-7pm which I wasn’t able to make it due to family commitments. Room was fully furnished and updated, in-room safe, mini-ref, large bathroom with large counter space, with a standup shower, living space, a closet, and lots of drawers too, this was way bigger than expected!

reviews.text: We love the Silverton and enjoy all it has to offer.  The staff is friendly, helpful and knowledgeable.  The rooms are clean, beautiful, and comfortable.  We love bringing our family and friends to the Silverton to enjoy all that it has to offer.  We will be back.. soon

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: This is our second time staying at Silverton. We like being off strip where it isn't so crazy. Their recently renovated rooms are great. The beds are comfortable, loved the room blackening shade. The only negative for us was the shower set up. To turn on the water, you have to step into the shower. So, you either turned the water on and scooted out until the water was warm or adjusted the shower head to point at the wall and ducked under the spray until it was warm. I loved the rain showerhead though. There is a body wash/shampoo, and a conditioner mounted on the wall in the shower. There is an armoire with hanging space and drawers. That is also where the Keurig coffee maker is located. (They had Starbucks k-cups.)The casino has a large variety of games and tables, with 4 poker bars. (Hubby had a lucky streak and hit a progressive royal in the first 15 minutes we were there). The Sundance grill has an extensive menu with many options that should appeal to everyone. The beef barley soup was delicious. I had the "cup" which was huge (the size was like a bowl anywhere else). My husband had the prime rib french dip melt with fries. He said it was really good, and the portion size was perfect. We also had breakfast there, also good. They have this really neat aquamarine that is huge. Per the info it is over 100,000 gallons. It has a large variety of fish, and they put on "mermaid" shows throughout the day. There is a 2 story Bass Pro shop. Even if you aren't an outdoors fan, you have to go see it, it is truly unbelievable. All of the staff from the valet, hotel check-in, housekeeping, bartenders, wait staff in the casino and restaurant, were friendly and welcoming. We didn't use the pool but walked out and around it. It is heated and open year-round. They have a humongous tv that was broadcasting sports (hubby thought that was awesome).If you are looking for a great place to stay or play, without all the craziness of the strip, I highly recommend Silverton.

reviews.title: Silverton Hotel and Casino is outstanding place to enjoy Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Must stay when in Vegas
reviews.text: Every single person that works at the Silverton was so helpful and cheerful. We utilized the airport shuttle service and it was very easy to book online and our valet was so accommodating. The rooms were amazing and the beds were extremely comfortable. Blackout curtains were very helpful since we were adjusting to the time zone.  Our absolute favorite area was the pool. The ambiance is amazing with palm trees surrounding the pool and 4 giant screen TV’s playing sports related channels. Again, top notch service from Douglas, Oliver, & Monica! Trust me, book a gazebo if you plan on spending the day by the pool. There’s a mini fridge in each gazebo which is well worth it when it’s 100+ degrees outside. Multiple dining options available and it’s directly connected to the Bass Pro Shop. We aren’t gamblers so I can’t speak to the casino side of the hotel. I will say that they allow smoking in the casino, but the ventilation system is so good that you almost don’t smell the smoke. The aquarium with mermaids is a very nice addition and calming to watch. Highly recommend for people looking for the quieter side of Vegas. We will always stay at the Silverton when we return to Vegas based on this visit!

Customer service was great in showing us where to get a taxi from and the real reason I am writing this is the 2 valet guys . They were fantastic,they  chatted to us and shared their huge knowledge of las vegas with us and we sharing our irish sporting knowledge of hurling with them  till our taxi arrived . They were great which speaks volumes of the hotel and all the other staff too . Thanks guys

reviews.title: Nice stay
reviews.text: Our experience at the Silverton was great!  It was very clean, friendly staff and really nice pool area called the Swimming Hole. We enjoyed the nightly mermaid show and they have a good selection of restaurants.  When in Las Vegas, we will definitely return and we highly recommend!

reviews.title: Perfect for us
reviews.text: Loved this hotel. It is beautifully decorated. Our room was perfect. Again, loved the decor, the bed and bedding couldn’t have been better. We were on main floor which also was perfect. It was quiet and so close to the ‘action’. Only complaint is the toilet paper, a little rough on the bum.Pool was gorgeous! Very resort like. The casino was great. $5.00 blackjack tables were perfect for us that are not willing to blow our life savings on poker. An improvement in dealers attitudes would have kept us at the tables a little longer. Their attitudes were a little off putting, kinda crabby. Bars are plentiful and service was good.Loved being off the strip. This will be our go to in Vegas from now on!We are an older couple not into crazy partying and blasting music. It was perfect.

reviews.title: Great Stay!!
reviews.text: The room renovations are fabulous!  Very modern bathroom with large walk-in shower.  Very clean and spacious room with a comfy bed, fridge with a glass door, and nice coffee bar neatly hidden in the clothes armoire.  The pool area is fantastic with lots of lounge chairs.  I will definitely again!!

reviews.title: Weekend stay
reviews.text: Stayed at Silverton for the weekend . It was the best . Really clean . Price was good . Staff was super nice . Wasn’t crowed like on the strip . Will definitely be coming back . Family oriented as . Bass pro shop next door was an added plus . The store was really clean as  well .

reviews.title: Don't miss out on the Silverton Hotel.
reviews.text: This is a great hotel to stay in off the Las Vegas Strip. The hotel was very clean staff was very friendly. There were several restaurants inside the hotel and right outside adjacent. The pool was great it had music a bar also a huge TV screen. The mermaid display was superb. The bar and grill Inside the Hotel at excellent entertainment at night. I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: We had an amazing time!
reviews.text: The rooms are so nice and are also very clean which I appreciate since I do bring my kids and grandkids, the pool is warm, clean, and very kid friendly! The casino and restaurants were amazing, honestly everything was great, the front desk supervisor that helped us was really nice and the staff was so friendly.

reviews.title: Pleasant Stay
reviews.text: This place just recently renovated less than a year ago. Nice and clean and the front desk staff were very helpful. Our family always try to check out this place first and see if they have the availability before elsewhere. Will definitely stay here again. Thank you Silverton! See you soon!

reviews.title: Awesome stay at the remodel  Silverton Hotel and casino.
reviews.text: Just walking in and be greeted by the front desk with I smile I knew it was gonna ge a good weekend, had stayed in other hotels on the strip but they’re always too crowded that’s why we decided to try Silverton, we were not disappointed, in fact we ate at their restaurants and the food was yummy!! We didn’t even have to go anywhere else.

reviews.title: The Silverton exceeds expectations
reviews.text: The Silverton Hotel is truly Las Vegas hidden gem. Everything from the rooms to the Casino, Silverton Hotel is A+. Also, the staff does a great job at making you feel like family. The Sportsbook is top notch. The table games are exciting and well-maintained, offering a great variety for all types of players. The staff is knowledgeable, and always willing to assist, making the gaming experience even more enjoyable. Moreover, the pool area at the Silverton Hotel is a real oasis in the desert. The pool employees are attentive and ensured me and my family was taking care of while having a relaxing time by the pool. Their excellent service adds to my overall experience.Overall, the Silverton Hotel is my forever hotel in Las Vegas. I get everything I would at every other casino but without the large crowds and chaos. You have to give it a try for your next visit to Sin City.

reviews.title: I was charged a "Resort Fee" that was not disclosed.
reviews.text: I was charged a "Resort Fee" that was not disclosed.  When I got to the check in desk they said I could not check in until I paid a resort fee.  I complained that this wasn't disclosed.  They said that was because I booked through a third party.  I believe they should insist the third parties disclose the fee.  The "resort fee" is for things most hotels provide such as a coffee machine in the room & WIFI.  The WIFI was not working.

reviews.title: We can't wait to return to the silverton. Front counter staff was very helpful. Got signed into my room early.
reviews.text: We can't wait to return to the silverton. Front counter staff was very helpful. Got signed into my room early.

reviews.title: Relaxing and Fun
reviews.text: Right from the time we landed. Courtesy, Luxury Vehicle/Shuttle pick up and drop off back to the airport.Front Desk, Belinda and Staff were amazing and friendly!Casino/Resort/Swimming area was clean and the Different Food options were delicious.  Had a Blast!

reviews.title: Best place to be in Vegas!!!
reviews.text: Best beds in Vegas!! Beautiful pool beautiful!  Love the remodel!! Exceptional!!  Food in every venue was top notch! Staff was excellent in every area of Hotel & Casino.  We were there 4 nights and extended 4 nights due to the Global shutdown and everyone was so accommodating to us  just amazing! We can’t express enough how wonderful the Silverton Hotel Casino is just AWESOME!   Thank you and this is my new favorite place to be in Vegas!!

reviews.title: Friendly staff makes all the difference at the Silverton Casino & Lodge
reviews.text: First time stay for us at the Silverton Casino & Lodge in South Las Vegas was very relaxing. The Strip was congested and roads were blocked in prep for the up-coming Formula One event - so we welcomed the off-Strip calm at the Silverton. My wife maintains several salt-water aquariums at home so she was mesmerized by the aquarium inside the Casino at the entrance to the Pro Bass Shop. The odd combination actually works - taking a break from the casino games to shop in the Pro Bass store adds to the fun for all ages. The staff - from housekeeping to the table games - are all customer-focused and treat you with kindness and respect. My blackjack dealer was actually apologetic when she would pull off an incredible draw of 21 to beat my 20...LOL. And you know what they say about slots: The further away from the Strip you get, the higher the RTP rate. I can vouch for that!UPDATE: July 26 2024We returned to the Silverton for another enjoyable stay...in spite of the 100+ degree blazing hot weather. Thank goodness the AC at the Silverton was handling the heat without a problem. The only "heat" we experienced was at the slot machines: I was able to walk-away with enough of a profit to pay for my wife's new laptop!  So, all in all, just another fun stay at the Silverton.  We don't miss the Strip at all!

reviews.title: Love Silverton
reviews.text: Highly, highly recommend as a Vegas local if you want to stay off the strip but be close enough. Warning though the smoke smell is very strong here. Always enough parking. Machines are good. Restaurants are good. If my family wants to take a staycation, this is where we go!

reviews.title: I love Silverton
reviews.text: Conveniently located, good parking space, excellent casino host, excellent food options. Excellent stuff, More perks for clients, more promotions to get you playing. I've been to several casinos but I have made Silverton my home because they take care of me

reviews.title: Amazing time at Silverton.
reviews.text: Silverton is an amazing place. Love the new pool. The rooms are clean and new. Silverton has always been one of my favorite places to stay when visiting Las Vegas. The restaurants are amazing. If you like Mexican  or sushi, this is the spot. And the all American breakfast at the Grill is good way to start your day.

reviews.title: Amazing staff and hotel - highly recommend!!!
reviews.text: Great location, really pleasant atmosphere, good food/service and clean rooms, but the thing that makes this such a great place and experience to stay...was the staff. Everyone was so incredibly kind, gracious, helpful and patient with their time. My parents who are elderly, had an amazing time and under the circumstances [no AC at their home, with sweltering heat] one of the nicest places they've stayed in many years. I can not thank you enough!!!! [Review post coming from their daughter who lives in a different state and had minutes to make arrangements before heat exhaustion set in.

reviews.title: The best place to stay.
reviews.text: The best place to stay.  It's off strip, and that's not a bad thing.  I prefer it.Free parking, no traffic, great internal variety of restaurants to choose from, very accessible to outer fast food, and gas stations, etc...They seem to care more than other hotels.  Everyone, from the front desk, to everyone on the floor/ etc... are very helpful, if you ask anything.I love the fact that I can text any requests, or questions that I have.I've stayed here multiple times, and will continue to keep on coming back every time I come to Vegas...

reviews.title: Hands down our favorite Hotel and casino
reviews.text: The bed was the most comfortable bed I have ever slept in.  The machines were hot and Mi Casa was amazing.  This is my fiancé and I’s favorite hotel and casino in Las Vegas hands down.  We had an amazing experience with the new pool.  The weather was hot but the pool was cool and inviting.  I can’t wait to come back to the Silverton!!

reviews.title: Hidden gem
reviews.text: The renovations to this hotel are amazing.  Room was very comfortable, spacious and had everything we wanted.  The pool was relaxing and fun.   Staff was attentive and friendly.  The silverton is a great place to have the vegas vibe without the overcrowded craziness of being on the strip

reviews.title: Hotel away from the strip
reviews.text: Great rooms, nice amenities and very helpful staff. Overall great experience. They have an upgraded pool. I enjoyed watching a movie on the big screen while i was in the pool.  Their rooms are also remodeled and upgraded. The beds were comfortable and the pillows were soft. The prime rib at Sundance Cafe was delicious and the noodles at Wuhu are fantastic.  I would stay at Silverton again.

reviews.title: The Silverton Casino Lodge and Pool is a beautiful place!
reviews.text: The new pool, The Swimming Hole, is beautifully designed. It really is gorgeous. The servers were extremely nice and engaging. I sincerely can't wait to go back! The hotel rooms are large, the beds are comfortable. The Casino has all the latest slot machines. Plus there is a giant aquarium with Mermaids.

reviews.title: Silverton - Favorite Staycation Spot!
reviews.text: My family and I decided to do a staycation at the Silverton for the 4th of July weekend. What a wonderful experience. The new look is spectacular! From the perfectly decorated, detailed, comfortable room to the exquisite pool! Our stay was an incredible experience, with excellent customer service from all team members and yummy food at Sundance Grille, Mi Casa, Johnny Rockets, and the Swimmin’ Hole. Silverton you did not disappoint! Can’t wait to go back!

reviews.title: Great place to get away in Vegas
reviews.text: Great overall place! Relaxing and great service. Off the strip but easy to get there and enjoy, then get away from the crowds afterwards. Beautiful upgrades to the rooms and pool area. Also, great dining place to go. I recommend for everyone to experience Silverton.

reviews.title: Best off  the strip accommodation!
reviews.text: The recently remodeled Silverton hotel/Casino our go to choice for lodging when visiting Las Vegas. The rooms are comfortable, clean and quiet. The staff is always warm and welcoming and service is outstanding. The new pool area is also relaxing and offers food and beverage service. It’s always nice to visit here!

reviews.title: Silverton Hotel and Casino is a hidden gem
reviews.text: Everything from the beautiful rooms and pool, to the friendly front desk staff and bartenders , Silverton is a hidden gem. We will definitely be back! The casino is clean and smells good too! The Mermaids in the Aquarium are amazing! Twin Creeks Steak house was excellent.

reviews.title: Relaxing stay with delicious food and great gaming
reviews.text: Beautiful and comfortable rooms as the lodge had a complete renovation last year.  Restaurants serve delicious food and there are fast food restaurants inside the casino: Johnny Rocket's, Wu Hu noodle (restaurant quality Chinese food), and Starbucks.  Also able to walk to Bass Pro shops from within the casino. The casino is spacious, has a cozy feel with subdued lighting and numerous slot machines to keep you entertained.  Video poker is very good too.  Free parking.  This is a place to stay to get away from the noise and crowd of the strip casinos.  I am usually a downtown patron but Silverton casino is a better value.

reviews.title: Highly recommended
reviews.text: The best resort hotel so far for when staying in Las Vegas...rooms are newly renovated..staff are friendly and most of all the casino floor is very clean plus machines are very generous.  My 2nd time to book my stay here and will always come back.

reviews.title: Great Place for family
reviews.text: First trip to vegas with the family in a while and wanted to stay away from the strip. Absolutely happy we stayed here. New renovated rooms looked great, Sundance grill food was good, the new pool was amazing, staff and service was great. Kids loved the mermaids and Bass pro shop, we will be returning.

reviews.title: Fathers day! Well spent with Family
reviews.text: Room are spacious and beds are comfortable. Celebrated fathers day at the casino and well spent with the family. Food at the pool restaurant are delicious and affordable. All staff are very friendly and we are able to communicate properly with whatever our needs.

reviews.title: Silverton Resort and Casino has been our best choice compared with some hotels and casinos we stayed before.
reviews.text: Silverton Resort and Casino has been our best choice compared with some hotels and casinos we stayed before.

reviews.title: Amazing experience. Had such a great time.
reviews.text: Had the best overall experience ever. Casino floor awesome, pool was fun, pool staff amazing. Rooms are beautiful. Can’t wait to go back. We rented a cabana and it was perfect. The food and drinks were great, and a great value. All the staff was so friendly.

reviews.title: A hidden gem!
reviews.text: The room are comfortable and beautifully decorated.  The pool area was lovely.  Can't wait to stay again!  All the staff was welcoming and helpful.  The food in the cafe was excellent and the wait staff was friendly and prompt.  I like staying off the strip and away from all that hustle and bustle.

reviews.title: Excellent get away
reviews.text: Excellent place to go everybody is very nice excellent food and really nice Hotel very clean and the pool is very nice highly recommended make sure to check the Acuarios great place to take the kids so they can enjoy the mermaid show the Casino is clean and a good variety of Slots

reviews.title: Minnesota Couple Vegas Often
reviews.text: The new remodel has really refreshed the hotel. The staff is exceptionally friendly and helpful, perks are the best and we love the great choices in slots. Some of their penny slots we do not find in other casinos and the video poker is the best!

reviews.title: Father's Day trip.
reviews.text: We've visited for over 10 years. We just did a Father's Day trip for 2 nights and a pool day. The hotel and pool remodel are fantastic. Normally we would go out to Fremont or the strip but this trip we spent all our time at the Silverton. The property, staff  and food choices made for no reason to leave. Definitely a resort feeling!

reviews.title: The best kept secret on the strip!
reviews.text: This resort is a gem in the rough. The grounds and location were perfect. Near shopping and highway, easy to get around town.The facility itself was awesome, casino filled with great restaurants and connected to a bass pro shop that is like a museum. The room was warm and comfortable and had a cowboy vibe, it was great. The pool was beautiful and set up perfectly. The bar was inviting and THE BIG SCREEN TV WOW, I watched the hockey playoffs in the pool while enjoying my scotch! Great place cannot wait to come back and we do twice a year.

reviews.title: Greatest hotel in Vegas
reviews.text: I had the greatest visit at the SilvertonLodge. My room was the best room I've ever stayed in . In Vegas period  I'm sure there may be others but Silverton lodge will always be my choice hands down. Also the pool was nice and clean and relaxing...

reviews.title: My first visit to Silverton Lodge
reviews.text: From the start, the friendly hotel check-in staff made me feel comfortable and welcome. My room had a delightful pool view and the beds were extremely comfy. I dined at 4 establishments in Silverton and the food and  service was excellent in each. Check out the sushi rolls and chile rellano  in Sushi Casa!

reviews.title: One of the Best place to stay!
reviews.text: This place is awesome! If you don’t want the traffic and chaos of the strip, this is the best place to go! Newly renovated rooms and a sparkling pool! A lot of activities to do in this place. With lots of loose machines! Restaurants are affordable and serve delicious food!

reviews.title: GREAT stay, will return and recommend
reviews.text: From the moment we walked into the Silverton, we were treated so kindly, felt they appreciated our business and went out of there way to offer guidance etc. off the strip about 10 minutes by car. We did not see much of surrounding area as our focus was relaxing n casino time after strip stay ( park mgm, see other review) and sight seeing to Grand Canyon, art 66, red rock etc. This resort was great and we chose it based off other reviews. I concur, book it! The resort was spotless, the staff Excellent from check in to wait staff to pool staff, bar staff, rewards/cashiers. Everyone was Happy to interact with guests. There are multiple restaurants within the resort ( we ate at Japanese/very good, Mexican Excellent, diner style, good food but too slow on service both times). There are other eats as well. The game play/slots were Very Good as I did limited tables, can’t comment on that. They offered various ( much appreciated) comps ( like 50 off meal, free slot play/free table bet). and even daily specials. I do wish there were More kiosks to check as one needs to use kiosk rather than at the slot to get some comps/extras. We saw security walking  inside, outside and felt safe and looked after. Must use room key to get into hotel area, pool area, and within elevators. The room was spotless, took a basic room no upgrade views and it was perfect for us. Coffee/fridge/closet/safe/drawers chair/table. Loved the decor/theme, the hall was a bit darker with tin ceiling but so cool.  Great decorator Chairs by elevators! The Huge aquarium with mermaid show was a nice view and fun to watch mermaid. Bass pro attached ( which we frequent) but having a great time in casino/pool, never even entered it!  The Pool area is beautiful and No crazy fee for big beautiful thick cushioned loungers with umbrellas!  The outdoor bar, drink specials, entire pool area, even had  water bottle filling station, spotless area and spotless well equipped bathrooms. The pool staff was Excellent! There is a food/drink menu.  They offer shuttle to airport which is about 10 minutes door to door. Great Stay and we will likely return. It was peaceful to be away from the hectic strip and greatly enjoyed our stay at Silverton Casino Resort!

reviews.title: Best Deal in Town
reviews.text: The best deal in town, if one plays. Better comps here than we got at others in Las Vegas. No heavy traffic to deal with and easy parking. The remodel was fantastic. The pool is just right, did not use this trip, but will be back in July. Food options are really good, WuHu is still good as always. The food in the Sundance is so good too, the chefs do a really good job. My brother in law loves the pizza. I must say it is as good as any place, and Sundance is not even a Pizzeria. We may not always win but the machines do pay.

reviews.title: The Silverton Western-Themed Resort was a great place to stay, play, and relax
reviews.text: We have played penny slots and card tables numerous times before at the Silverton on our trips to Las Vegas. When we heard the Silverton Hotel was renovated into a boutique type hotel, we jumped at the chance to stay.  We were happy we did.  Every detail had a western flair, and the decor was just right. Everything was comfortable and, at the same time, classy.Staff members were friendly and helpful. The swimming pool area was very well done with fire pit conversation areas and plenty of seating and shade.  Lounge chairs were thickly padded, and towels were easily accessible.The location is ideal for those who don't want to be in the crowds up north on the strip.  This southern strip location still has everything to offer.   The Silverton boasts a really huge casino, several restaurants and bars, fast food outlets, a gift shop, and a  beautiful,  unique tubular fish aquarium where mermaids swim among dozens of fish to the delight of young and old alike.  There are shows with various original entertainers and those who sing and play just like original artists.  There is an enormous Bass Pro Shop attached with great decor as well.  The parking garage is very large, with ample parking to handle various special events for sure. Overall, it was a fun and relaxing place to stay, convenient without all the noise and crazy crowds.

reviews.title: WOW! Seriously BLOWN AWAY!
reviews.text: WOW! My little family of three was BLOWN AWAY by the Silverton. The immense attention to detail is top notch, to a level I haven’t seen in Las Vegas in years. Remember when you were able to go to Vegas and there were tiny little perks that just amplified your whole trip? Look no further than the Silverton: free wine tasting (generous pours) upon checking in, $2.50 draft beers in casino bars ALL DAY, and free coffee service from 8-10am at the pool! And THE POOL-talk about luxury- clean, ample lounge chairs, huge TV that hangs over a stellar bar (shows movies Tuesday nights!) and again-attention to detail: the pillows at the pool even say, “Tan Your Hide!” It’s all just SO well done, cohesive, clean & chic. The pool has sun loungers IN the pool, too. The beds in the room are seriously comfy & the Western meets Vegas theme of the room is fun and tastefully done with just enough camp without going overboard. The curtains are BLACKOUT for some serious sleeping in & relaxation (like seriously-no detail was left undone). Great Starbucks down in the casino & WuHu Noodles was some of the best Asian food I’ve ever had. DoNOT sleep on the Silverton because it is “off the strip.” You will NOT be disappointed staying here & the strip is a cab drive away. Go, go, go!

reviews.title: BEST HOTEL IN VEGAS
reviews.text: The Silverton is home.  The staff is amongst the friendliest we have encountered. No need to leave the facility, they have it all !  Super good dining choices, Starbucks, Johnny rockets, sushi, cafe, grill ... all are amazing and easy.  The new rooms are quite comfortable and nicely decorated, the new pool is amazing.  Can't wait for our next trip!

reviews.title: Worth the stay!
reviews.text: Great place to stay. Rooms were beautiful and the staff made our stay enjoyable. Food was excellent. Casino has lots of new machines!! Pool was great with 4 huge screen TV's and poolside service was a plus. Our stay finished up with entertainment from the Power of Love Band! Had a blast!

reviews.title: Relaxing Resort Value
reviews.text: incredible remodel. As a business traveler I look for ways to make my time away from home and family the best possible experience. I want easy, comfortable and enjoyable. Silverton checks all the boxes. Start with not walking miles between parking and getting to your room, or no hassle check in and out. The latest in Room amenities with AC that truly cools the larger rooms, and a Big TV that includes my streaming choices. Add to that never having to leave the property because it has everything you need including great restaurant choices with prices that are very affordable. The Sundance restaurant staff is always amazing at making you feel like you’re an old friend. Starbucks inside the lobby that even lets me order ahead. Entertainment is always available or I relax by walking through the Bass Pro shop or get lost staring into the aquarium as I eat my Jonny rocket burger I got just a few steps away. I didn’t go in the water but had to check out the complete pool remodel. Definitely an outdoor oasis with details that include phone charging stations and an outdoor audio system that somehow blends in to deliver amazing sound quality with balance and clarity.A location that’s not jammed in the middle of a convoluted transient mess. Getting away from the strip hustle and filth makes it truly a Resort style feeling. Being Surrounded by people that seem to be enjoying that same vibe helps build what separates it from the hype of other properties that tend to be hit or miss. I’ve tried the others and they just aren’t able to deliver the total experience I want. Why it’s my first choice: Relaxing, Staff, beautiful facility, clean, easy, safe environment with everything you need at a good value. It just adds up to make the difference over the normalize craziness that seems to be attached to other options.

reviews.title: Hidden Gem Off The Strip
reviews.text: This hotel is the cutest little hidden gem resort. Off the strip and feels like a boutique hotel! Rooms are decorated so cute with much attention to detail, very cowboy chic. The rooms are very clean with luxury bedding. I don’t believe I will ever stay anywhere else when coming to Vegas. It’s a super easy Uber to the strip when necessary. The casino is super clean and new feeling and you can’t even tell people smoke in it. Every staff member we dealt with was amazing from booking over the phone, checking in, the server at the restaurant, even the players club cashier; all extremely friendly and helpful. Also, they may have the best steakhouse I’ve ever eaten at if you want to feel a bit bougie!We will be back! We want to try out the swimming hole!!!

reviews.title: Great place to stay and play!!
reviews.text: The remodeled rooms are beautiful. The remodeled pool area is amazing. Bar tenders and servers in the pool area were friendly yet professional while providing excellent service. Husband and I rented a cabana one day and received outstanding card and service. Staff members at this casino/hotel provide excellent service while being friendly and helpful no matter their position. Valet and bell cap service is great. Would recommend this hotel/casino to anyone. We have stayed here many times over the years and will continue to do so!!

reviews.title: I would definitely come again definitely got my money's worth highly recommend this hotel
reviews.text: Customer service was awesome hotel was beautiful rooms were clean and nicely decorated and housekeeping was honest got my items back that I had left there The aquarium is absolutely gorgeous valet parking very helpful help us get a taxi to where we wanted to go

reviews.title: Silverton Casino Lodge, My number one choice in Las Vegas.
reviews.text: Our 2024 Marine Corps Officer three-night reunion was a wonderful experience. I've been a guest at the Silverton Casino Lodge many times. This time it was the best. Newly refurbished rooms. Extremely polite and efficient staff. Maria for room service, Kelly in the restaurant, and the check-in desk help. And the Bass Pro Shop attached was handy for gift purchases.

reviews.title: Great Vegas drstination
reviews.text: We always have a great experience when staying at Silverton. The remodeled hotel rooms are always clean and comfortable, the food at the restaurants is delicious, the Casino is fun, and the remodeled pool area is wonderful and relaxing.  Finally, the service is 1st class in all areas.  Highly recommended by us as a destination when in Vegas!

reviews.title: Jarhead13
reviews.text: Everything is first rate in every respect. No leaf unturned!! Everyone went out of their  way to make everything enjoyable. The boat ride was great. Ed Roski and his entire staff made it a memorable stay!  I hope the decision is made to have it staged again in two years!

reviews.title: Hit the Jackpot with this Casino Lodge!
reviews.text: We were looking for accommodations off the strip as we are honestly not big Las Vegas fans! I booked this casino based on good reviews and we were not disappointed. The location was convenient right off the freeway. And there were lots of good amenities nearby. The check-in staff was most accommodating and very friendly.
