reviews.text: Our one night stay was great ... nice room, friendly staff.  Buffet was good, nice selection of machines on the gaming floor.  Would definitely stay again,  Security was helpful wit parking our oversized vehicle.

reviews.title: Welcome Home
reviews.text: My stay at the Silverton was fantastic! Checking in and out was simple and pleasurable due to the knowledgeable staff. Our room was clean and comfortable. We ate at the Grill, the Buffet, and the Steakhouse and all meals were very good. The Buffet offers an abundance of choices. The Grill has an extensive menu. I ordered a BLT that was out of this world. As a matter of fact, you could have probably made two sandwiches out of the amount of bacon that was in this sandwich. YUM! We made reservations at the steakhouse and were not disappointed. The service was exceptional and the prime rib melted in your mouth. The layout of the casino area is comfortable and inviting. I love the penny KENO games that are offered. If you like to play multicard KENO, you won’t be disappointed. I also love the idea of having a Starbucks on the premises. Sipping on a Mocha, eating hot pumpkin bread and playing penny KENO... who could ask for anything more? I even managed to pull myself away from the casino long enough to go shopping at the Bass Pro, which is conveniently attached to the casino. Overall, our week long stay at the Silverton was fantastic and I can hardly wait to return. When I’m at the Silverton, I feel like I have all the comforts of home.

reviews.title: Bass pro
reviews.text: I would go for bass pro not to gamble , rooms are ok nothing outstanding, small casino , not many people there when we were there. Maybe if more people were there payouts would be better. Bass pro excellent store large and very we’ll stocked.

reviews.title: Affordable lodging, with several caveats
reviews.text: The Silverton is affordable and has some beneficial amenities; however, that is all I can say for the positives.  The walls are paper thin so it made it challenging to get a good night’s sleep.  The toilet leaked and the room had an odd smell to it.  They had challenges checking me in and out with billing.  The Silverton has a very large aquarium which at first seemed neat, some of the fish and sting rays looked rather unhealthy; one of the largest stingrays (See photo) appeared to have had its tail cut off.  That made it hard to feel good about staying there.  It isn’t the worst place, but I don’t know that I’ll be going back.  It served its purpose for a business trip.

reviews.title: Good place to stay
reviews.text: Not the top notch, but affordable and nice place overall for the money spent. I've stayed at most locations in Vegas, but this one I feel has great value and we always get a good deal. The fish tank alone is great, but add the fact you can walk through Bass Pro Shops, it's a good deal all the way around. The rooms are older but there is a new addition with newer rooms on the property. Cracker Barrel is right there for food if you don't want the casino food.

reviews.title: Nice Stay
reviews.text: I always like staying at the Silverton quite off strip with easy access to strip.  Pool is generally quite so its easy to relax and get away. Onsite restaurants are good and there is plenty places close to eat.

reviews.title: Gem of a Vegas Hotel
reviews.text: This is our 4th stay at the Silverton. The staff is always top notch. The restaurants are delicious and the rooms are very nicely appointed. You are far enough off the strip to avoid the hustle and bustle. It’s like a boutique casino.

reviews.title: Silverton Stay
reviews.text: I have stayed at Silverton several times in the past and always found the rooms to be comfortable. This stay we were put in a room that had a deer's head mounted on the wall. It also featured a photo on the wall of a hunter proudly standing over his trophy--a dead moose!!. What disgusting decor!! I would have asked for a different room but was only staying 1 night. Also was not offered any discount coupons for the casino eateries upon check-in. Silverton would always include these discounts in the key packet in the past.

reviews.title: Relaxing at Silverton
reviews.text: The absolute beat place to stay in Las Vegas. Very friendly and helpful staff. The steakhouse,  the buffet, Mi Casa, Wuhu Noodle, the Mermaid lounge, and Season's Grill were all exceptional!  Even won a little money.

reviews.title: THEIR TOWELS ARE DISGUSTING
reviews.text: Towels are disgusting they are very worn out and almost grey color. Theres strands of hairs of the previous guests in the shower. The shower curtain smells like a towel that didnt dry and then you put it inside a plastic bag and sealed it.

reviews.title: Not a kid friendly or a well kept Hotel
reviews.text: This Hotel is not kid friendly and was dirty and not well kept. Pool equipment was broke in several areas (not safe) and the casino had no ventilation, so if you were to just walk through to get to your room and you dont smoke, hold your breath. My family and I stayed for 1 night and left with soar throats.

reviews.title: FOOD INFO
reviews.text: could use more late night food/desert options. lines are long/wait time and staff seams a bit overwhelmed. Very little kid options. VERY BRIGHT SIDE 4TH OF JULY pool party great all aspects. See u all soon!

reviews.title: Pleasure at the Silverton
reviews.text: we had a Relaxing time at the pool & service was great.Service at the check in was great & friendly & helpful service Rooms were clean and beds were comfortable tooWe will stay here next trip out to Vegas

reviews.title: Great Las Vegas Casino Hotel
reviews.text: Though far from the Las Vegas strip, this hotel offers s nice room, pool, restaurants and gaming experience (though I do not gamble).My room was large and comfortable and the staff was helpful (though when I arrived and also during my stay, there was only one front desk person on duty).I will stay here again when I visit my friends in the Las Vegas area, and I recommend it for everyone else!

reviews.title: Our favorite hotel in Las Vegas.
reviews.text: This is the only hotel we will stay in in Las vegas. We love the location, the Casino, and the staff. The only downfall was the dismal internet speed. We had almost no cell phone service in room 1007 and really needed a decent internet speed for communication purposes.

reviews.title: So good
reviews.text: All around the stay here was phenomenal. I had left my wallet downstairs and went back and security had already received it and took good care of it. Cleaning crews were constantly moving around. Smiles on everyone’s faces and guest services was perfect

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: I have enjoyed my stay at this hotel, the rooms are very comfortable and the noise is low, that is why I continue to stay at Silverton Hotel.  The food at Twin Creeks has always been excellent and priced just right.

reviews.title: Good, Except for Kids in Casino & No Mini-Frig in Room
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay except for a few things. The first thing we noticed was “Why no mini-frig in our room?” We’ve come to depend on them as a place to store our medication. Also, get the kids out of casino!

reviews.title: Silverton Hotel and Casino
reviews.text: This is a great location if you want to be slightly off the strip and have easy time getting in and out of the hotel.  It is a smaller casino but I enjoy that as you don't have to worry about having a hard time locating your friends.  It is a casual casino so no need to dress up.

reviews.title: Road trip 2019
reviews.text: Want to stay someplace that makes you feel like your part of a family, off the Strip? Then this is your place! We visit Las Vegas 2 or 3 times a year, but never stayed here until now. From now on this will be our place in Las Vegas!!

reviews.title: Our stay
reviews.text: Great Place to stay, other than the room not being cleaned. But I didn't compalin, we.had plenty of.towels for the nextday. Will stay again. Food is excellent t !!!!! Li!e that the casino floor is not smelly!

reviews.title: great time!
reviews.text: great time excellent casino i will be back again  loved the food, the atmosphere the staff all but one craps dealer he had an awful attitude  i left the table among others till he was gone then we went back to playing but had a good time

reviews.title: Good stay
reviews.text: We stayed at the Silverton for only one night coming back from a visit to the Grand Canyon. It was close to the airport and a very reasonable rate. However we had a challenging time finding the hotel. There is a tall time-share in front which was confusing, but we eventually found the hotel. Then it was finding check in. It is not by the door so one has to look around for signs and directions.The room on the fourth floor was spacious and quiet. There was a lack of plugs so I had to unplug a lamp to plug in my c-pap machine to sleep. There is also no fridge or microwave in case of dinner leftovers. The bathroom was small for the size of the room. The toilet takes up half the floor in the bathroom. In the main room there is a comfy two person couch with a coffee table as well as a desk chair so plenty of places to sit. Overall this is a good choice for a visit to Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Couples weekend
reviews.text: We prefer to stay at silverton rather than at the strip like the rest of the party because we always have great experiences as we always do. The fact that theyre next to bass pro shop is an icing on the cake since our family loves going camping as well.

reviews.title: Anniversary Stay
reviews.text: Excellent time had by all! Clean, friendly, and any small issues were handled with ease.Food was excellent and a great value in Twin Creeks.  The cabana was clean and the poolside  service was excellent.

reviews.title: Silverton Stay was Fantastic
reviews.text: Great restaurants, clean rooms, friendly staff and absolutely the easiest and quickest check-in on any hotel casino I've experienced. I was in and out in less than five minutes.  We ate breakfast at the hotel instead of waiting an hour at Cracker Barrel and was very please with the food quality and price.

reviews.title: very disappointed.
reviews.text: very disappointed with our stay. we travelled from Melbourne Australia. the pictures looked like its from a different hotel. the rooms were small. nasty smoke smell old and outdated rooms. would not recommend to travel with kids

reviews.title: Fun
reviews.text: Excellent, Staff, Facility, Gaming, fun, fun, fun. Never had a problem, love the food options, time of operation, and décor. Just a great time, relaxing and did really enjoy the pool and spa. Even the inhouse store was a wife hit. She found some real specials.

reviews.title: Another great stay.
reviews.text: I really enjoy the lodge atmosphere here. The relatively smaller size of the property allows for a more personal experience in my opinion. Very nice pool area, a decent fitness room, a really good buffet, and parking only a few minutes away from the room are all great perks.

reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: Very much enjoyed our stay....loved the aqurium ! We enjoyed the food at the coffee shop, and the bed was incredibly comfortable. The price was great and my husband liked the proximity to Bass Pro Shops.

reviews.title: Great Off-Strip Locale!
reviews.text: Had visited Silverton on a previous trip to check out the property, see the awesome aquarium, and play in the casino. The general lodge-styled feel is accented with contemporary flair in some areas, and redneck charm in others. Speaking of which, Bass Pro Shop is directly attached to the casino. The staff is great. The food is above average. Our room was very nice. Great location off the strip! We will be back.

reviews.title: viist
reviews.text: I enjoy coming to Las Vegas to get away from everything since last year i couldn't go anywhere because i was going though chemo so this year I'm traveling and getting my life back. We always go to the Silverton because we like the promotions. Hope that we can still get them or try another place

reviews.title: 1st stay
reviews.text: Good free parking, not too crowded, away from strip, good looser slots, good customer service, carpets are worn down, you can hear footsteps from top floor, resort fee reasonable, $5.99 steak and eggs after midnight only for guests 21 and up (what!!!) Sorry kiddos! They ran out of poke last time we ate at the Luau buffet.

reviews.title: Best Value In Town...
reviews.text: Best Value in town... friendly staff and free drinks aplenty. Stay here every time and they never disappoint...good gaming and food variety not to mention the Bass shop for a shopping excursion next door.

reviews.title: Great off strip Hotel and Casino
reviews.text: Been staying for past 6 yrs on Fremont Street at the Downtown Grand.  Booked The Silverton at a friend's recommendation.  I think I have found my new hotel and casino.  Great casino, and a mermaid bar that's incredible. Oh ya and Bass Pro shop.  I will definitely be staying there more often.

reviews.title: Great Value
reviews.text: The hotel is off the strip but close. Everything is nice and cheaper than on the strip. If you don’t care about the buzz of the strip, it’s a great hotel/casino to go to. There’s nice rooms, a good casino with all the tables and slots you want, a big sports book and a nice resort style pool.

reviews.title: Silverton vacation- great location and easy access from car to room.  Don’t have to do the maze walk to get to room.

reviews.title: Great vacation
reviews.text: Excellent place to stay and relax for vacation. Hotel provides lot of promotions, food and slot credits. The lobster dinner is best though you have to wait for more than four hours. Slot tournament is exciting, and prizes are generous.

reviews.title: A GEM in the Desert
reviews.text: I like this place for its location and service as well as value.  They have nice restaurants with variety of food.  The Chinese Restaurant has great food and service.  Buffet was excellent on Friday and Saturday.  They should limit the smoking near the restaurant area.  Wifi can be improved.

reviews.title: We love the silverton
reviews.text: The silverton is a great place to stay. The restaurants are awesome and have great prices, the rooms are clean, the pool is so nice. We have stayed at the silverton each time we go to Vegas and we look forward to staying again!

reviews.title: Best Place to stay off the strip!
reviews.text: Sliverton has the best restaurants in Vegas. Also there beds are comfortable. Drinks at the bar are fair priced. The staff are friendly and willing to help any of our needs. I will definitely come back soon

reviews.title: Aquarium is awesome!
reviews.text: Love the ambiance.  The mermaid aquarium is amazing!  The Sundance grill has the best midnight menu in town.   I like the atmosphere and location to hang out with clients or friends.  It's a great local place close to but off the main strip.

reviews.text: Went for a relaxing week. Hotel has great restaurants and a gorgeous aquarium & art exhibit. A very fun bar called Shady Grove Lounge that has Ladies Drink Free Happy Hour Sun-Thurs 4-6. Got to try some wild Concoctions. Great service everywhere.

reviews.title: Anniversary trip
reviews.text: As always, the staff is amazingly friendly and helpful (especially Lori at the front desk) and our food is always excellent at Sundance (Country and Bananas Foster French Toast), Mi Casa and especially Twin Creeks.

reviews.title: Hotel street view is misleading.
reviews.text: As you approach this casino/hotel you will see a nice new looking high rise building that looks like a hotel and it has a huge lit sign on top spelling " SILVERTON" which leads you to believe that is where you will be staying as a guest.  It is not! The actual hotel is much older and in need of updating. However, the room was clean and the bed comfortable. The ground floor level hallway had a musty smell. Check-in went smooth and employees friendly and helpful.

reviews.title: Great place

reviews.title: nice peaceful place to relax for couple days
reviews.text: Very relaxed atmosphere and can still have fun......games are improving to latest and greatest.  Enjoyed the pool area with lots of umbrellas.  Restaurants are surprising very good, always love the mexican food place.

reviews.title: Relaxing
reviews.text: Our room was clean and the bed is soooo soft, we love it. We regretted not able to bring out swim wear for the pool and workout outfit for the gym. We had buffet for dinner and played at the machines. We enjoyed our stay.

reviews.title: 48th Anniversary Celebration
reviews.text: We stayed at Silverton for our 48th anniversary.  Clean, comfortable, & very roomy rooms.  Very friendly hotel staff.  The casino also has very friendly staff. Plenty of different kinds of gambling machines.  The Mermaid lounge had nice entertainment.  So glad we went there.  The only disapproving thing was the lobster buffet.  We waited 3 hrs in lines only to get cold & dried out items.  The lobster itself was good.  The sushi station wasn't as great. Will definitely go back but not for the lobster buffet...

reviews.title: Harder to find but worth it
reviews.text: Terrible hard to find hotel check in!!!  Parking is a challenge, too much smoking in the casino but neat aquarium, attached to Bass Pro Shops, lots to do and see, friendly staff, room was very weirdly shaped and nothing special,rates sound good until they add all their resort fees and such!  No free breakfast or even cheap breakfast on premise.

reviews.title: The Silverton Hotel and Casino is a Great Place to Stay
reviews.text: This is an overall, hands down, great and pleasurable place to stay.  The staff, restaurants, and other amenities are quite pleasant and desirable.  The early Am breakfast is tremendously great.  I think anyone, single, couple, or family would do great staying here.  The Mermaid feature is a good extra treat for all of the family!!

reviews.title: Away From the Hustle and Bustle of the Main Strip
reviews.text: What I like most is the location. It is away from the hustle and bustles of the main strip. The surrounding and ambiance was calm and suited for a vacation which I was able to have. I also like the fact that the ventilation was also very good because being a non-smoker, my sinuses is trigerred by the smell of  cigaretter smoke. Unlike the other lodges where I smell the cigaretter smoke as soon as I enter the facility, Silverton has a very good air ventilation system.I will come visit again and I will make sure to return to your lodge.

reviews.title: Great base for our Road Trips.
reviews.text: To be clear, this was a 5 Star stay at a 4 Star casino.  The Silverton has something the strip casinos does not have and that is a laid back atmosphere and some much needed peace and quiet.  We did road trips to Death Valley and Joshua Tree and the Silverton is right at 160 (to Death Valley) and I-15 (to Joshua Tree), so it was the perfect place for us to stay in Las Vegas for a few nights.  Service was very good.  The front desk was very nice.  We ate at the buffet one evening (different review) and everyone there was nice too.  The casino didn't do me any favors.  I was up a little and then I wasn't, but that's the way it works.  You win some, you lose some.  We did not use the pool.  It is on the small side, but nice looking.  The Mermaid Bar looked cool, but I was with my teen daughter, so I didn't make it in there.  There is also a huge Bass Pro Shop attached to the resort, which is worth a look.The room itself had comfortable beds.  The TV was good.  There was some empty space in one of the corners of the room.  It really could have used a small desk area and a chair.  It was wasted space.  As with most Vegas resorts I looked at, there is a resort fee.  Parking was simple and plentiful.  We parked around back and there is an entrance you can go in right by the elevators, which was very nice.Our stay was really good.  I would not have a problem staying again.

reviews.text: We recently visited the Silverton on their Friday night Lobster buffet evening. We waited in line for a full 2.5 hours which is fair enough as this is obviously a very popular sitting. However I question the time people who were already seated were taking - wouldn’t it be better if the Silverton put a time limit on how long people could stay at their tables this would surely make the line move quicker. The food was excellent and outstanding value. However I had indigestion as shortly after being seated we were told that we had 25 minutes left before the food would stopped to be put out. Clearly this wasn’t fair as early stated previous dinners were taking a great deal of time.

reviews.title: Silverton casino Las Vegas

reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text: The only plus was the bed was comfortable. The food was awful. There are no waitresses anywhere. You are allowed 1 drink and it needs to be completely empty before ordering another even if it takes the waitress 30 minutes to return.  Very tight machines.

reviews.title: Family Fun!!!
reviews.text: It was a family trip in total my group rented 6 rooms. We had a blast gambling as well as the children in the pool. We were able to eat all 4 days in the hotel. Did not really have the need to go out of the hotel. All amenities were there. We are planning to go back soon .

reviews.title: Quality Hotel and Casino
reviews.text: Thumbs up all the way!  Probably in my opinion one of the best Hotel and Casinos out the Las Vegas Strip.  Weather you are visiting, passing thru or vacationing in the Vegas area, I would highly recommend the Silverton, you will not be disappointed!

reviews.title: None
reviews.text: We selected Silverton Hotel and Casino because it is near our home and it was the first time for our son and his family from Hawaii to stay there They usually stay in another hotel whenever they come to visit us.

reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.text: We recently stayed five nights at the Silverton, visiting family in Vegas.  The service at Silverton was top notch, from making the reservation over the phone, to the front desk, to the bartenders and serving staff at the restaurants, everyone we encountered was helpful and friendly.  The front desk is a bit hard to find, tucked in to the casino.  Our room was dated for sure (as other reviews have stated) but extremely clean and housekeeping was spot on.  I do miss the coffeemaker/fridge/microwave in the rooms, though.  It was fun to shop at the attached Bass Pro Shop and the Silverton maintains a massive aquarium which is fun to watch.  Free parking was a plus too, as was easy access off I-15.  It seemed family friendly.  The pool is great, I wish the pool bar was open later. The ladies staffing the pool bar were fun and friendly.   Somehow, you can not hear any noise from the freeway when you are in the pool area, even though the freeway is just over the fence.  Great landscaping throughout.  I think we hit all the restaurants, food was great, although the service was spotty at times, like someone called in sick and the server was struggling.  We can't wait to return!

reviews.title: Wonderful stay!
reviews.text: Once again, a great place to stay! Everything from the value, casino, restaurants, beautiful pool area, staff & location were great! The Silverton has been our favorite place to stay in all of Vegas. Looking forward to my next stay there.

reviews.title: Great place!
reviews.text: Clean room, comfortable bed, polite staff, fun pool, and good restaurants. I highly recommend Su Casa, their sushi is excellent! The hotel was also very quiet. I didn't hear any noise. Overall, a great and fun place to stay at!

reviews.title: Great deal. Get a player card!
reviews.text: Solid for price. Having a player card helps with food costs. Good restaurants. Bass pro shop provides a little shopping break. Starbucks located in the casino is nice. We enjoyed the aquarium. Its a good value for the price

reviews.title: Good time!
reviews.text: We were in town for our granddaughter dance performance. We didn't want to stay on the strip so this Hotel was recommended by a friend.  We had a great time. The mermaids were a big hit.  Service was excellent, all the employees were very friendly.  The only problem we had was the bathtub would not drain.  But, we would definitely come back .

reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.text: We were in the second floor with private patio overlooking the pool. Shout out to my casino host Meriam! She’s great and very pleasant to deal with. I would definitely recommend this hotel.  Great staff.

reviews.title: Nice place to stay
reviews.text: This hotel is quite a nice place to stay. Rooms are comfortable, restaurants are good. I'm not a huge gambler but the casino has plenty of variety. Easy access to the Strip. My husband and I enjoy shopping at the Bass Pro Shop.

reviews.title: Little gem and such friendly employees!
reviews.text: We were only here for a very short stay (arrived at 3 am after a delayed flight!) but from the second we pulled up we were greeted with top notch service. Our vallet Reggie was exceptional, the front desk staff was super nice, the beds were cozy, and the aquarium was awesome! We plan to stop back to see the mermaids before we fly back to PA. Also- super affordable!

reviews.title: Silverton Hotel 100%
reviews.text: The location and the free parking is a WONDERFUL perk! The quietness of the pool and the staff are great. Price is good. Plenty of good places to eat and the Casino is just right. Not to smoky like others.

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: On a positive note the new Su Casa is amazing! The service was excellent. On the negative side, someone should check the headboards on the beds in room 2055, I had to cover them in order to sleep because they were so disgusting, unacceptable!

reviews.title: Very basic hotel room
reviews.text: The double queen room we stayed in was accommodating for our four night stay. There was no refrigerator,  no microwave, And no coffee maker. There was not a vending machine on our floor. It’s hard to stay in the hotel rooms for longer stays without the simple accommodations.

reviews.title: Quick Low Cost Getaway
reviews.text: We had some comps so we took a quick trip here. Casual typical older casino attached to Bass pro shop. We stayed 3 nights and used this as a base for our VEGAS trip. If you are looking for a low key location this is it. Be sure to check out the giant aquarium.

reviews.title: Great time
reviews.text: We loved that you are off the strip. Pool bar Sway and staff Lawesa & Tiarra were the best ! The mermaid bar food and drinks were good. The food at buffet was disappointing as everything was bland and not hot enough. Valet staff was very friendly !

reviews.title: Silverton Las Vegas
reviews.text: Great little casino with friendly folks. A good value for your funds. Casino Hosts a little Stingy though. Great Buffet for the money. Connected to Bass Pro Shop. Best Bass in the world and worth the trip to see the store. Great aquarium too.

reviews.title: Will be back
reviews.text: Came for my cousin's wedding at the Veil event center. Everything was beautiful and nice. The room was amazing, location is ideal and I enjoyed myself. I will definitely come back with my husband. The event center was awesome and beautiful. The food was delicious as well. Wonderful experience overall.

reviews.title: Fun time at the Sliverton
reviews.text: Spend one night and half a day at the Silverton Hotel,  room was neat, clean and was very comfortable.   Food was very good at all the resturants and staff was friendly and made you feel welcome.   This place is just off the Strip and has a wide variety of machines.  Could you a few more 5 blackjack tables.   If you join the players club you get lots of comps and often a free room.

reviews.title: Nice calm place
reviews.text: I like the Silverton as it is not on the strip and it is much calmer than those that are.  I am not in favour of the resort fees charged by hotels in Las Vegas as they are sometimes more than the cost of the room.

reviews.title: Off Strip Casino Runs a Good Craps Game
reviews.text: If you're on The Strip playing Craps the table minimums are $10, $15, $25 even $100. With that they only let you take two times odds - somes three, four, five times; but, that's it. You go south just a little way to the Silverton and find craps games with $5 and $10 minimum bets and 100 times odds. It gets better: 12 in the Field pays 3 times instead of two on The Strip. There's more:$10 bets on 4 or 10 are automatic Buys that pay $19 instead of $18. If you like to get ripped off, play Craps on The Strip. If you want something close to a fair game check out the Silverton.

reviews.title: Great value
reviews.text: The hotel is a great value. They have great staff, great customer service and great restaurant options. Only negative would be that the rooms don't have great soundproofing and people tend to be up late at casinos.

reviews.title: Off the beaten trail but great place to go
reviews.text: I usually stay at Silverton Hotel when I go to Vegas as it's not so crazy like the strip and offers great restaurants and gaming.  It seems as though more locals go there.  They offer shuttles to and from the airport and that is a deciding factor for me.  Always friendly drivers that take care of you. Rooms are a bit dated, but clean and pool is smaller than other places but staff is friendly, drinks are good and they have a nice variety of restaurants.  If you eat at Twin Creeks Steakhouse it will be hard not to eat too much bread.  It is absolutely the very best bread I've ever eaten with an excellent variety so crusty and delicious!!! and (homemade).An added perk is the Bass Pro Shop and Aquarium.

reviews.title: Qualitier
reviews.text: Avoid the congestion and madness of the strip with quick car access to shopping, interstate, and other casinos.   Always have a pleasant hotel stay and prefer playing in the casino over those on the strip. Staff friendly and helpful.

reviews.title: Best start to a vacation
reviews.text: Very inviting when you walk in. (The kids loved the fish tank). The staff and service was excellent. The staff  always greeted us and thanked us when we left. Plus having bass pro right there I for one couldn't be any happier! Only downside was no fridge.

reviews.title: Peacefulness in Las Vegas
reviews.text: My favorite place to stay in Vegas.  Never had a complaint in all the times I've been there. The food is great.  The games are fun.  The aquarium is nice and Bass Pro Shop always makes a for a great shopping experience.  It's the only place in Las Vegas that I feel comfortable being at.

reviews.title: Memorial Day Weekend at Silverton
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time from arrival to end we loved this place is really clean and all of the staff are very helpful and make you feel comfortable Love the Bartenders they’re great and the Restaurant’s are really good can’t wait to go back

reviews.title: Heading out a Las Vegas.

Wasn't very busy for a Friday afternoon. Looked into the possibility of staying there but 1899 Resort fee kind of dissuaded me. It was a nice location for my wife who had a royal flush on her video poker machine.

reviews.text: Not very good ,kids running around above us ,reported to Security,no obvious action taken ,kids still jumping off beds,Service was unacceptable at Mi Casa,unable or unwilling to seat our large family gathering of 16 .

reviews.text: Very clean hotel and casino inside and out.  The staff is very friendly (except one, don't know her name) and  accommodating.  Good choices for dining.  Twin Creeks is fine dining.  The food is excellent there.  Good late night breakfast specials. The smoking rooms are the furthest away from the elevator on the second floor.  I'm a smoker and I don't use one. Too much of a hike!

reviews.text: Very hard to win.  They changed the point accumulation too.  Housekeeping services were not good.  Got sick at the Twin Creeks restaurant.  I have been here many times and it seems to be getting worse not better.

reviews.title: Stay at Silverton
reviews.text: I love Silverton.  I am fond of the friendly staff and the warmth of the atmosphere.  I love the size of the casino as I am not a huge crowd person.  Food is exceptional at the Sundance café.  Buffet has such a variety. Slots are current.  Will continue to stay there.

reviews.title: Great stay for a little staycation
reviews.text: Big room, super comfy bed, and not much outside noise.Enjoyed the Happy hour at Twin Creek Steakhouse-great prices and very good food.  Too cold to use the pool but had a DJ outside and a food setup-great deal brisket sandwich, soda, chips, and mac  salad $5.  Plenty of bars and lounges to just have a drink or set and gamble.   Loved the big aquarium and watching the fish and the jellyfish aquarium behind the bar.  Silverton also has a huge Bass Pro Shop with all kinds of cool things to check out.  With had a fantastic time.

reviews.title: Great beds and value
reviews.text: Always enjoy staying my only annoyance is the cigarette smoking in the casino. I truly enjoy the pool & playing slots there! Love Twin Creeks but didn’t eat there this time. The Seasons buffet has a very nice offering. Friendly staff at Silverton!

reviews.title: Great Service at a great price
reviews.text: We had a great time in your Hotel and Casino. We were there for only one night unfortunately, but when I come back, I will come back and stay at the Silverton again!! reviews.text: When we discussed the room, we said, oh just give us the Best and Nicest room, and that is exactlywhat she did. Dining was excellent.We enjoyed the Casino but did not have much Luck.We are looking forward to our next visit, maybe our Luck will improve.

reviews.title: Best Las Vegas place to stay
reviews.text: Easy to get to. Easy to park. Easy to check in. Easy to get players card replacement. Elevators close to check in. Comfortable room bed bath climate control water pressure good in shower. Wish mini fridge was included

reviews.title: Cozy friendly home away from home.. gambling and food is great
reviews.text: I love visiting I go no where else. They treat you like a VP when you just common. Make it feel like a vacation you have waited for all year. Thank you for that.. I have been many places and either the staff or food or rooms are horrible. This place has it all.

reviews.title: Great visit
reviews.text: Just was there overnight, but everything went well.  Was visiting to celebrate my Aunt's first anniversary of her death.  She died at 105 years of age on May the 18th of 2018. She was living with my cousin and her husband in Pahrump, Nevada.

reviews.title: The Unexpected
reviews.text: This was my very first time staying at Silverton and it did not disappoint. The staff were courteous and helpful.  The rooms where very clean and the food at the hotel was very cheap.  They even have steak and eggs for 6 dollars from midnight to 5 a.m. If you are a table person, this is the place to go.  There are less stupid players here then on the strip.  Also their side bets are only 1 dollar compared to the strip which is 5 dollars.  I will definitely come here again.

reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.text: We love the Silverton and the Bass Pro Shops. The staff has always been friemdly and the beds are very comfortable. We spend most of our time there on visits and sometimes take a short Uber ride to the strip.

reviews.title: Loved the Casino, Hated the Room
reviews.text: I like to play the older style slot machines.  The Silverton has a good selection of both older and newer machines, and I was ahead a few hundred dollars when I left the casino.  My room was a big disappointment.  The mattress was so worn on one side that it was like sleeping on a slope.  I have only stayed overnight at the Silverton one time, so I hope my room was not representative of all they have to offer.

reviews.title: AS USUAL
reviews.text: We have stayed here numerous times . always a good experience. the staff is very professional. close to the freeway  and you can miss all the traffic and take the tram if you need to go into town or the airport  always like the bass pro shop and the aquarium.

reviews.title: Will Return
reviews.text: Love staying here.  Check in was quick.  Room was immaculate.  Prices are great and it's easy to get around town.  They have shuttles to the airport and to the Aria.  Otherwise you need a car.  Plenty of restaurant choices here.  We ate at the cafe and at the buffet.  Both were great.  No complaints.

reviews.title: Best kept SECRET of Las Vegas
reviews.text: This is the place to stay while in VEGAS! The staff is outstanding. This place is what vegas use to be like.Off the strip quiet! But, close to everything. The restaurants are all GREAT and the food is OUTSTANDING! All the video machines you could ask for and about the best KENO machines anywhere I have been. Great COMP's!

reviews.title: Quick trip to silverton
reviews.text: Quick trip to vegas so we stayed at our favorite hotel and casino. The Silverton is always a great place for us. The steak house Twin Creeks has an amazing happy hour and the food is top notch. I recommend the lobster avocado!  Yum!

reviews.title: Another great trip
reviews.text: As with our other trip to the Silverton, we enjoyed our stay.  Fun playing the slots, great meals at the restaurants and nice room. The staff are always helpful and pleasant. We look forward to our next trip.

reviews.title: Survey for 5/15 stayed at Silverton Hotel. Excellent!
reviews.text: Room access was very convenient from the casino. Enjoyed the table games. I wish the resort fee is cheaper since we never use the swimming pool. We both don’t swim. We don’t use the gym either. Our intention is to play slots and table games.

reviews.title: Great property.
reviews.text: We stayed for one night and the room was good. Window opened witch was awesome for some fresh air. Bed was super comfy and good fluffy pillows. Check in and check out was fast and easy. Good value. We enjoyed the casino and restaurants during our stay. Comps are good.

reviews.title: Nice uncrowded place to stay. Not as hectic as the Strip
reviews.text: I booked the Silverton Hotel because of a concert that was to be held there. It was a great experience and the staff was wonderful. The location was well off the strip and was not as hectic as I was expecting it to be. I will definitely recommend this place to others.

reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: Friendly staff and room was very nice.  Love this Hotel and have stayed there many times.  Great value and very nice restaurants.  My wife and I have stayed at this hotel many times and love to go and stay there for a little get away from Kingman Arizona.

reviews.title: Nice room
reviews.text: Enjoy our stay. Restaurants and Starbucks and pool hours could stay open later would be nice. Review is a bit annoying when it requires a minimum of 200 characters. I already said all I need to stay so this is stupid that I have to keep typing to get it to 200. Oops past 200 good bye

reviews.title: Lunch with my son.
reviews.text: As always, my stay was great. Everyone I delt with was so kind and helpful, starting with shuttle driver to the cashier that helped me out. The only thing is if I could have won some money. I'll be back to try again.

reviews.title: Little gem off the strip
reviews.text: Friendly and accommodating staff, many eating establishment ‘s to choose from, central location for experiencing many sites that Las Vegas has to offer, and very close to McCarran airport. Will definitely return!

reviews.title: Casino was great.
reviews.text: Casino has a lot of various slot machines. They even had .75 cents ones. Staff was very friendly. They also had various of national restaurant inside of casino. Also next door is the very big Bass Pro Shop. Plenty of parking on the outside.

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: everything was great, food, casino, service, I love the fact that the casino does not smell so much when people smoke, love that the air conditioner is always on even if its cold outside that helps the air not to smell so much like smoke

reviews.title: BEYOND  GREAT
reviews.text: Rooms are very comfortable and clean. Everything else from staff to food is GREAT,and  BEYOND GREAT.  We stay there all the time and LOVE it.. Cant find a better BUFFET three times the money. Go hungry.  Off the strip on Las Vegas Blvd half way between strip and airport. Just a short ride on lift to where ever your going. Rooms are  always VERY clean and comfortable, Not fancy.

reviews.title: Fun Trip
reviews.text: The room was excellent and in an ideal location. Beds were the best. All amenities were great, got ref. which came in handy.  Ate twice at the buffet and both times food was well prepared and hot. Also ate at the Sundance rest. and again the food was excellent. The pool and hot tub were also very good.

reviews.title: Nice small Las Vegas Hotel. Excellent customer service and good selection of restaurants on site.  customer service..
reviews.text: Nice small Las Vegas Hotel. Excellent customer service and good selection of restaurants on site.  customer service..

reviews.title: Loud plumbing pipes
reviews.text: Brought my child with me asked for a rollout bed never showed up, Plumbing Pipes made up loud noises all night long could not sleep. Front desk said  they knew there was a problem and would have maintenance check it out

reviews.title: Hidden Gem off the Strip
reviews.text: Best place to stay off the strip! Friendly staff, great food and very clean! The pool is awesome and is kept nice. The restaurants had a nice variety of foods. Best value for the money - also free shuttle to the Strip and airport!

reviews.title: Great Hotel Experience
reviews.text: The staff are courteous and helpful,  The rooms and entire hotel is very clean.  Large pool area.  Quiet, restful environment.  Great food in the restaurants.  I would recommend this hotel for everyone.  We stayed 4 days and looking forward to our next visit to the hotel.

reviews.title: Helping a Homeless Veteran.
reviews.text: From Helen to Leona. The staff provides a service that is rare in Las Vegas. Some people like to be on the Las Vegas strip. To have a better perspective and appreciation, I would recommend staying at the Silverton to keep a breath of fresh air, while enjoying your potentially, once in a lifetime trip to Las Vegas. Whether you try to recreate "The Hangover", "21", "Casino" or any of the other Las Vegas produced movies, you have experienced.

reviews.title: Wi-fi trouble
reviews.text: Could not get good wi-fi connections anywhere  on the proberty or near.  If you need wi-fi to work or for any other reason (and who doesn't) you might want to try somewhere else.  Everything hooked up and worked fine at three other hotels in the area.  We will be staying elsewhere in the future.Everything else was excellent but without wi=fi, we cannot stay there.  Even if it was a unusually situation, it took way to long to correct.  All 3 days it was not letting my wife connect to her VPN for work  She was there to work and meet with friends but working had to happen during the stay and was a real problem.

reviews.title: Vacation getaway
reviews.text: Great offstrip atmosphere!It’s very comfortable place to stay and close to shopping and other casinos ,the pool and the hot tub  are small but very nice. The casino action is very good ,you always feel you have a chance to win!

reviews.title: Exceptional and Friendly
reviews.text: This property is a all round value. Friendly, professional and knowledgeable staff. Rooms are exceptional nice. Very nice and varied available restaurants. Air circulation is top notch, hardly able realize the smoking atmosphere.

reviews.title: Book if you like unified guests entering your room at any time.
reviews.text: Keys were intermittent, had people walking into my room with actual keys in the middle of the night, no one believed me until I found the intruder. Terrible experience I would no longer recommend even though I have stayed before. Lots of pot smoke in the hallways.

reviews.title: Overnight
reviews.text: Quiet and convenient to the airport   Staff was helpful when I explained I had a very early flight and preferred a room on the first floor close to the front so I didn’t have too far to go early in the morning

reviews.title: excellent
reviews.text: We had a fabulous stay at the Silverton - the staff was excellent. The food was excellent.  We were there for 5 day and did not have any complaints.  I'm sure we will return our next time in Las Vegas. There was a lot to see in the hotel and Bass Pro shop.

reviews.title: complaint
reviews.text: We stayed in the Silverton hotel on Sunday, May 5th. The bathroom shower was moldy. The air conditioner did not work so someone had to come in and fix it late that night. They put us in a handicap room which we did not ask for. The was no ice bucket in the room, only a lid which we thought was odd. . . but all we wanted was a good nights sleep and to get on the road early the next morning. Much to our surprise we got a phone call the next day from a guy named Francisco. He accused us of stealing the ice bucket and was going to charge us $59 for it. We told him we did not take it and were appalled that he would say such a thing! He was rude and would not back down so we went above his head. In an email we explained everything that went on and how we do not steal the ice bucket. She never got back to us even though we called and left a message too. So, we are going to try and talk to the owner next. This is not over. We want an apology for being accused of something we did not do. It's so sad the way customer service has declined over the past ten years. We will "never" stay at this hotel again!!!

reviews.title: A reasonably priced clean, comfortable hotel off the strip.
reviews.text: Silverton is a fine place to stay off the strip. Clean rooms, comfortable beds. We ate at several restaurants including Johnny Rockets, Sundance Grill, and Mi Casa. They all had good food and were reasonably priced. We didn't gamble so I don't have any input on the casino.

reviews.title: Marine Corps Reunion
reviews.text: Among the smaller hotels/casinos of Las Vegas, the Silverton staff is without equal in professionalism and friendliness.  In all regards... from the front desk, to valets, to restaurants... the Silverton focuses on, and delivers, exceptional customer service and satisfaction.   One of the finest small hotels we've had the pleasure of enjoying.  Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Always a great stay
reviews.text: Staff is friendly, pool and rooms always clean. Rooms always smell fresh. Restaurants are great food is AMAZING. We've never had to make a complaint about anything. Plus the comps are the best, if you have a chance stay at Silverton you'll love it.

reviews.title: Outstanding hotel and casino!
reviews.text: We had an exceptional time at the Silverton Hotel and Casino.  The staff is extremely friendly, the rooms are clean and spacious and the food was delicious!  It's a wonderful place to stay and I highly recommend it.  The Bass Pro Shop is also a nice, interesting place to visit while staying at the Silverton.  It's connected to this hotel/casino.

reviews.title: SUPERB !!!!
reviews.text: A superb experience. The hotel staff are exceptional. The food was wonderful. The housekeeping staff were pleasant and responsive. Everyone seemed truly concerned for our comfort and enjoyment. The wait staff were attentive and cheerful.

reviews.title: KBay reunion 2019
reviews.text: Excellent spot for a large gathering.  Good food, excellent rooms, lively casino.  Our Marine Corps reunion was very well organized and supported by the staff.  No problems at all.  Would highly recommend this resort and casino.

reviews.title: A Very Friendly Hotel
reviews.text: Everyone we came into contact with had a smile on their face and assisted us in every way possible. This is a culture others strive for, but few attain the way Silverton has. Our room was very clean and all meals at the hotel were excellent.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Everything was perfect.  The room was very clean, bed very comfortable.  Away from the hustle and bustle. The service was great.  Liked the least, no coffee pot in the room.  Liked the bed the best.  Good drinks in the casino.

reviews.title: Great place but Check for reunions first!
reviews.text: Love to stay here but had some amenities not available due to a large reunion that was being hosted there. They have a great variety of gambling. Love the aquarium and the Bass Pro Shops attached to the casino.

reviews.title: A Wonderful Home in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Great location!.  Great facility, with all  options available (food, gambling, swimming , entertainment).  Wonderful, friendly, helpful staff such as we have not seen matched anywhere else!  When in Las Vegas, the Silverton will always be our choice, as it has been in the past.  The management of this place has got to be truly superb!

reviews.title: Norm K-Bay 63
reviews.text: I found the Silverton to be first rate in every aspect - food, service, facilities and atmosphere. I particularly liked the aquarium bar.  The staff was very attentive.  The attached Bass Pro Sop was an interesting sidelight to the Las Vegas experience.

reviews.title: Outstanding Experience
reviews.text: My wife and I had an outstanding experience in our stay at your hotel, from beginning to end. Your employees are all friendly, courteous, helpful, and very competent. You are fortunate to have such quality people who act as our hosts.

reviews.title: A first-class Experience!
reviews.text: Can't recommend this property too highly! Everything about our stay was beyond expectations. Rooms were soundproof despite  close proximity to the airport.  Staff was exceptionally friendly, cheerful, and helpful.

reviews.title: excellent
reviews.text: Staff were most cordial and willing to see that your stay would be memorable.  The food served at all of our reunion gatherings were five star.  Cruise on Lake Mead was awesome and again, the staff were outstanding. Silverton Hotel/Casino is the place to go for reunions--they know how to do it!!!

reviews.title: STAY AT SILVERTON CASINO/HOTEL
reviews.text: What a great small casino/hotel.You get  bang for your buck staff are great.This hotel is small enough to give you personal attention. And the pro bass store attached to it is really great.We have stayed at a lot of hotels on the strip, and prefer to stay here.It is not on the strip but close, and they do run a shuttle.Plus you don't have all the lookie' loos coming in.

reviews.title: March 2019 trip
reviews.text: Bathroom is old.  The water in sink and tub slow to go down the pipe - plumbing.  Location is excellent near the freeway.  Room was clean except when using the sink and the tub, water was so slow to go down onto the drain.

reviews.title: Home Away from Home
reviews.text: We have been coming here for a very long time on our twice per year visits. It is so familiar to us, and we always have a great time. The restaurants are wonderful, the pool stays open in the evenings, beds are comfortable, and the rooms are good-sized. After 40-plus trips to Las Vegas, we don't care to be on the Strip anymore. Silverton has old and new slot machines, employees are friendly, and we just feel at home there.

reviews.title: Wouldn't recommend it if you are looking for comfort.
reviews.text: Room was hot and you couldn't control the air conditioning.  Furniture was uncomfortable and the room had a mildew odor. Casino was great but room was not. Over all hotel just looked old and looks like it lacks TLC.

reviews.title: Annual visitor
reviews.text: We enjoyed the shuttle service and found the slots were fun playing and not just taking our money quickly.  Miss the refrigerator in the room, ice machines need filters or changed if they have one,: funky tasting ice. Coffee on the casino floor was day old and tasted burnt, had to go somewhere else to get good Irish coffee.

reviews.title: Second stay
reviews.text: Our stay was ok.  The shuttle to Aria needs more frequent trips.  The pool side bar needs to be open more often during the week.  The beds are a bit on the firm side but the sheets had a nice feel.  All in all we had a decent time staying at the Silverton.

reviews.title: Vegas
reviews.text: Another pleasant stay at the Silverton. No issues and just great service all around. Had a few requests and all were met without any hassle's. Love this place. Easy in, easy out. Will be back in the fall, maybe sooner if possible.

reviews.title: Buyer beware!!
reviews.text: At first glance this place seems like a decent budget friendly motel. The casino is decent sized and reasonably priced, there is a good variety of food and the pool is very nice.... however BUYER BEWARE.  Apparently the resort rents out the pool for "private events" closing it entirely for all guests. There is absolutely no notice that this is going to occur prior to your arrival or when you check in for your weekend stay.  Instead, the hotel slides a note under your door at 3 am to apologize for the "inconvenience" of the closure for all day Friday and Saturday. The hotel helpfully (read sarcasm) let's you know that you can use the pool at the resort next door instead. What they don't tell you is that the hotel next door has no amenities in their pool..no bar service but more importantly absolutely zero access to towels. And when talking to guests at the next door hotel, it is clear that this resort doesn't provide those amenities because their guests don't pay the daily resort fee of over $20 per day, but YOU will pay the fee regardless of whether you use or even have ACCESS to those ammenities. So remember that when you drip back to your hotel room at Silverton, towel-less and irritated because the pool next door is not near the quality or caliber of the one you actually paid for.

reviews.title: Another great stay at the Silverton
reviews.text: This was our third stay at the Silverton Las Vegas. Everything was as expected... GREAT! Right from the minute we entered valet, through check in, the great room, the casino and restaurant staff, everything was wonderful. Thanks to Anthony, Alectra and all the staff for making this visit another memorable one for us! See you again soon guys,

reviews.title: Silverton 7
reviews.text: Need more outlets available on the dresser or some sort of outlet or plug strip. If not that a small side table so as to put the coffee maker on, so you don't have to put coffee maker in the bathroom and take the space from your vanity mirror.

reviews.title: Wife's birthday getaway
reviews.text: We had an awesome time at your resort, thr atmosphere is always friendlier that most casinos on the strip. My wife had a blast and we even invited my wife's family to come a d enjoy meals with us a few times. The noodle house was so delicious and fresh .

reviews.title: Off the strip
reviews.text: If you want to be away from the hustle, this is a good place to be.  Liked it for the family feel. Liked it was attached to Bass Pro. Also, nice pool area and outside areas to hang out in.  The Sundance restaurant was hit and miss.  The Noodle Restaurant was really good.

reviews.title: We lOVE the Silverton
reviews.text: We love everything about the Silverton, restaurants good variety,  rooms very comfy, slots loose enough to play if not walk away winning, location close to everythingThe staff is courteous, friendly, and accommodating.WE LOVE THE SILVERTON

reviews.title: Kid friendly
reviews.text: The employees were friendly, the restaurants were very good and kid friendly but my room this time was very disappointing. Have stayed here multiple times and has always been awesome! The pool is small but very nice and love the fact that you can shop at Bass Pro Shop which is just off of the casino.

reviews.title: The Best Little Hotel/Casino in Vegas
reviews.text: Thanks for a great stay.  We loved the rooms, the bed, the late checkout time, the friendly staff and the food.  You have our vote for an excellent, clean and well maintained property. We loved the pool and all the amenities you have to offer.

reviews.title: We will be back!!
reviews.text: Very friendly staff, front desk, players club, bartenders,housekeeping and restaurants. All of our needs were met. Our room was very comfortable. We like the restaurant choices and Starbucks in house. I just wish Starbucks would open earlier.

reviews.title: Bad Smells
reviews.text: We stayed at the Berkley next to the Silverton Casino.  If you want to spend time in a place that smells like your chain smoking grandpa's clothes that he never washes - but sprays with Fabreeze everyday - this is where you want to be. We gambled with Blackjack and slots and I have never seen such tight slot machines.We were never offered a complimentary drink.The only bright spots there are the WuHu Noodle Restaurant and the aquarium.

reviews.title: Great Hotel! Great Location!
reviews.text: We love staying at the Silverton! It is so relaxing and nice to be away from the crowds on the Strip. The front desk associates are great! Lots of dining options! It is a well kept property. The free shuttle is also a big plus!

reviews.title: Beware of Guest Services entering your room.
reviews.text: I put a "Do Not Disturb" sign on the door only to have a maid bang on my door around 9 AM standing there with a key card ready to enter. WTF? I asked why she banged on the door when the DND sign was there and she said " I wanted to see if you wanted the room cleaned" and walked away. That is not cool and odds are I won't stay at the Silverton again because of that occurrence.

reviews.title: Wow this hotel needs some serious refurbishing
reviews.text: Hotel is dark, worn and not clean! The hotel is way past the time to have been refurbished. Bathroom had hairs in the shower and on the counter. The location is convenient to the airport but unless they put some money in redoing the rooms, they can’t compete with nearby hotels

reviews.title: Silverton Stay
reviews.text: Loved the friendliness of employees in restaurants, gaming tables, and room service.  Have recommended the Silverton to friends and family.  Like that the casino is not filled with smoke.  Also important is the gaming tables are priced reasonable.

reviews.title: Best hotel
reviews.text: Quiet hotel with little to no kids which is nice. Farmers market on Sunday was great to get some fresh snacks for our room. Check in and out was quick and easy. Good variety of food and restaurants to choose from.

reviews.title: Convenient location for my trip
reviews.text: Great location, friendly staff, food was very good and the bed was extremely comfortable and the room was very quiet.  I was there on business so I really didn't utilize the bar service but having a Starbucks inside was awesome

reviews.title: pleasure
reviews.text: Silverton is unique so many casi8nos Hotels in Vegas ...but the Silverton is like your House incomparable   just extremely the Best I been in a lot of hotels in Vegas I learned the Lesson only the Silverton satisfy my need thank you Silverton staff

reviews.title: Great location. Good table rules. A old fashioned casino and the best beds anywhere. This casino has everything.
reviews.text: Great location. Good table rules. A old fashioned casino and the best beds anywhere. This casino has everything.

reviews.title: One night edge of Town
reviews.text: Loved the easy on and off I15 access. It was not as overly smoky in the casino, staff was very friendly and helpful. Buffet was very good value for the money, food tasted fresh,  not frozen.  Pool looked inviting. Room was clean and quite, on the side away from I15.

reviews.title: Our stay at the Silverton
reviews.text: Very comfortable pillow top beds, clean rooms.  We have been here a few times due to these reasons.  The staff is friendly and helpful.  We always enjoy are stay here since it "feels like home".  We had a wonderful time as always!

reviews.title: My review
reviews.text: I enjoyed your hotel. We loved the pool the service in the pool area was excellent.  The room was ok the bed was very comfortable. But you need to provide a coffee pot, microwave and refrigerator in your rooms

reviews.title: Spring vacation
reviews.text: Great location off of the strip.  The staff, from the front desk to the restroom attendants, are always very friendly and helpful.  We have been staying here for over ten years and have never had an issue that wasn’t resolved.  We will continue to stay here in the future. Great job Silverton!

reviews.title: Worst hotel I have stayed at in a long while!
reviews.text: I cannot think of one good thing to say about this establishment.  STAY AWAY!!!!  There rooms do not have coffee makers.  You must pay $15 to have a refrigerator in your room.  There was absolutely no excitement from the gaming floor.  Very disappointing!

reviews.title: guest room problem
reviews.text: toilet plugged  and flooded the floor after first used.had to push hard to get a room changed ,this inconvenient almost caused us to  miss our booked show! This hotel doesn't provide any cup for teeth brushing!They will deliver to your room if you request.Spacious room but only 1 chair in it .

reviews.title: Solid comfortable casino, just a bit out of the way
reviews.text: Silverton Casino understands its clients well.  Not really for the crowd on the strip, but a good fit for this couple.  Lots of gaming options, some elbow room, good restaurants (including a midnight steak and eggs deal).  Staff are consistently available, helpful and upbeat.

reviews.title: Tired
reviews.text: Once a favorite, the Silverton is “tired”. Clean and friendly staff, but room smelled musty/smokey. AC unit issues. No refrigerator in room or hooks on bathroom door. Cafe understaffed, took a half hour to get bacon and eggs.

reviews.title: The Unknown
reviews.text: Would have been nice to know that the pool was closed due to construction from the building across the parking lot.  Visited 2 years ago and seems that the restaurant prices within the casino are much higher than before.

reviews.title: HIDDEN GEM IN VEGAS
reviews.text: We have been going to Silverton ever since my children were kids.  My husband and boys  love to go to Bass Pro Shop while I do the slot machines.  Food is great , specially food at Twin Creeks. The promotions are great for members.

reviews.title: Silverton April 2019
reviews.text: The Silverton is a great value in Las Vegas. With all the amenities that you need to enjoy visiting. For us the value is the location the great food choices the lodge atmosphere and the hospitality of the staff. We have been coming and staying for the past 10 years and the property keeps improving.

reviews.title: Connie
reviews.text: Super comfortable beds and nice clean rooms. Great location. Great restaurants and fun things to do close by. My granddaughter loved the mermaids and my grandson and husband loved the bass pro shop. Would definitely come back.

reviews.title: Silverton Casino is our home away from home
reviews.text: I would tell anyone to come stay here but don't want to cause I don't want it to get too crowded, love it the way it is!! The beds are the most comfortable beds anywhere we took the info so we can get one like it!

reviews.title: Wind Noise
reviews.text: In between homes at present time.  Therefore, needed a place to stay for a couple of days. The room was clean, bed comfortable, shower water hot, & fluffy towels.  The only issue, the wind was blowing so hard that the wind noise kept me awake longer than desired.

reviews.title: Love this casino and hotel!
reviews.text: This is my favorite casino in Vegas. The hotel was affordable and comfortable. They gave us coupons upon arrival for their restaurants and stores. The noodle restaurant is our favorite. They also have great incentives if you like to gamble.

reviews.title: April 2019
reviews.text: Very pleasant and helpful housekeeping and registration staff (Lori). Have visited this hotel many times and feel very comfortable with everyone we have had contact with. Most restaurants very good.Would recommend to anyone.

reviews.title: Ok for a one night stay
reviews.text: We stayed here on our arrival night in Las Vegas. It was a short ten minute easy drive from McCarron airport. Check in and out were efficient. The corridors were a bit dark and dull and the carpet edges were pretty dusty. The room was a decent size but again quite dark and dull, with a view over a delivery area. The bathroom was small and outdated, in real need of modernisation. The bed however was fantastic and the linens and towels were fresh and of good quality. The TV was also a great size. The ice machine was located off the corridor in a large room which appeared to be a bit of a dumping ground for stuff. Not really the nicest place for guests to go to to get their ice. We never used any of the hotel facilities as we only stayed one night. However, the pool area looked really nice. Parking was free but the dreaded Resort Fee was added to the bill.

reviews.title: Nice Casino and Restaurants - Room just average
reviews.text: Stayed for 4 nights.  Rooms are nothing more than a Motel 6.  Just average.  Lots of highway noise as well.  Put room service card out for 4 nights in a row and it wasn't picked up any night.  Casino is clean and low-key.  Restaurants are good.  Ate the buffet and Sundance.  Entrance to Bass Pro is a plus.  A little ways from the strip, but close enough.  Pillows are like sleeping on a bag of hard foam cubes.

reviews.title: Very nice hotel and casino
reviews.text: Check in was very easy, unlike the strip hotels.  Room was very clean and inviting.  Lots of variety in food choices.  The buffet was excellent.  Although the hotel is not close to the strip, the hotel offers shuttle service.  I did not use as only stayed one night.

reviews.title: Pretty nice
reviews.text: The price if the hotel was very good, although I do not like the ‘resort’ fee.   Just make the price more for the room instead of sneaking it in with the ‘resort’ fee which is for what?? Nothing.   It’s not honest and I know it’s what the other hotels do there but you don’t have to follow them.  Room was fine and staff was nice.  The food at the buffet was not good but for the price it’s what was expected.

reviews.title: vacation
reviews.text: It has always been a go to destination that isof value in a great location, easy in and out, great service with the valet and is hassle free environment.It has always been a go to destination that is of value in a great location, easy in and out, great service

reviews.title: Great value at a beautiful hotel/casino just out of town.
reviews.text: I enjoyed my stay at Silverton very much.  Everyone was so accommodating and friendly.  All services were excellent and the free shuttle back to the airport was a nice way to end my vacation.  The casino offered great gaming and a wonderful selection of slots ( and I came out ahead) There were 10 different eateries to choose from and a nice pool outside.  This will be my first choice whenever I return to Vegas!

reviews.title: Friendly Staff, Good Location
reviews.text: If you don't need or want to stay at a big flashy hotel on the Strip, the Silverton may be the place for you.  The price is right, parking (valet too!) is free, the staff is friendly, and the casino is just as good as anyone else's.

reviews.title: Great Service all around!!!!
reviews.text: This is my second stay and my spouses first stay. We used the fitness center, swimming pool and the hot tube. The staff is top notch. The restaurants have a great variety of foods. I highly recommend the Silverton to my friends.

reviews.title: Not bad but not great either
reviews.text: Rooms were adequate, nothing out if the ordinary. The big building you think is the hotel is actually timeshares. The hotel is only 4 stories and off the casino. Check in is not adequately marked and is hidden, we walked by it three times. The mattresses in our room we're in need of replacement. They sagged pretty bad. The rates are great during the week but too high for what you get on the weekend. Optical illusion...not close to the strip. Like most other properties, the machines are tight... I don't think we witnessed anybody win more than a couple dollars our entire stay.

reviews.title: Good, not outstanding
reviews.text: Granted I have not tried other hotels in Las Vegas, so my benchmark is the hundreds of hotels in other cities in which I’ve stayed. The Silverton is ok, but not outstanding. Trying to find where guests checkin was a small task - the front desk is surrounded by casino, so you really are forced to ask. I used the free valet parking - a great amenity - and they directed me to the desk. Whether you use the “resort facilities” or not, you’re charged $18.99 + tax for the privilege. What’s with that? Even though my floor of the hotel was non-smoking, it had a mild smell. The hotel may be ripe for renovation. My room was fine - the bed very comfortable and I got a good night of sleep.

reviews.title: Honest Reivew
reviews.text: Overall experience was good. Bell Man, Santiago was very friendly and helpful. Rooms could be updated but were very clean, Beds and Pillows are the best. Casino was clean and welcoming with a variety of slot machines. Dining is great.

reviews.title: Stay Cation
reviews.text: Home away from home. Always enjoy my visits to The Silverton, weather it’s for shopping and eating or staying for a couple of nights. Everyone is always friendly and greets my friends and family with smiles. The Silverton is great!!!

reviews.title: Off the strip, value and great staff
reviews.text: Staff is great! They are welcoming and don’t have the normal unhappy attitude of “I live here and have been dealing for 20+ years, just Let me do my job.” I accidentally booked in a smoking room, and didn’t mind so much cuz the room had the hint of smoke but wasn’t overbearing for me to complain. I enjoyed my stay and already booked my next trip, this time in a Non-smoking room!

reviews.title: Great Business Trip
reviews.text: Excellent clean hotel. Minutes from strip. Great parking and easy access to I-15. The casino was one of the cleanest I have ever been too. Air quality was great for people wanting a casino not filled with cigarette smoke.  Highly recommend

reviews.title: Personal review
reviews.text: Great stay look forward to returning in the fall. Always a pleasure to stay at the silverton the valet service is one of the better assets they always remember me and take awesome care of my vehicle. Thank you

reviews.title: Low key and quiet
reviews.text: Low key and quiet. Not just the hotel and casino, but distance from The Strip also added to the calm. Additionally, when our room became flooded from the room upstairs, this at about 5:30 AM, the staff responded quickly to the emergency, and also to our comfort. We were immediately given a new room, right down the hall, but becasue we had an ADA room, they acknowledged the new room did not meet our needs, and by 11 AM, way ahead of the expected time, we were given a new ADA room. Very good. Oh, and it is worth mentioning that our walk from our parked car to our room has been the SHORTEST of ANY hotel we have every stayed in while in Las Vegas

reviews.title: Good value for the price
reviews.text: Bathtub was not very clean.  Pipes made noise every time the water ran.  Decor is dated with wallpaper peeling off.  Sofa cushions were very worn.  Restaurants food was excellent.  Ample parking.   Very quiet.

reviews.title: Silverton yes
reviews.text: We were very happy with our stay.  We were able to win enough to have a good time.  Not too flashy but nice. We rented a car so it was very easy getting in and out of the facilities.  Very good off the strip stay.

reviews.title: Vegas Trip
reviews.text: Always stay at the Silverton.  We like it very much. This time we had a slight problem. The bathroom doorknob looked like it had recently been changed, unfortunately it was put on wrong with the locking part put on the outside, so couldn't lock the door. Didn't bother to report it until we checked out because didn't want to have to change rooms and be inconvenienced while they fixed it

reviews.title: Fun times!
reviews.text: My wife and I just love your place! we feel its our home away from home! We usually have good luck in casino but we got skunked this time but we still had lots of fun. We will be back when it gets warmer as we like to sit out by pool and enjoy the warm sun. We also like the selection of placeces to eat at The Silverton.  The brunches are very good and very reasonably priced! The service at the bars and cocktail waitresses is also top notch.

reviews.title: Awesome beds and bedding
reviews.text: Slept really well, the beds and bedding were wonderful.  We like the atmosphere there, with the huge aquarium and outdoorsy feel, connected with Bass pro Shop....(my husband's favorite place, of course).The grill restaurant has a really good surf and turf dinner.  Not too smoky....all in all, was very pleasant and worth the price.

reviews.title: Always a Pleasure
reviews.text: Nice resort casino with good gaming and friendly staff.  Been coming here since it was previously known as Boomtown.  The restaurant selection is excellent ranging from casual to fine dinning.  The Bass Pro shop attached is a very interesting place for young and old to browse.  Will definitely visit again.

reviews.title: Sportsmans Paradise
reviews.text: Having Bass Pro Shops attached is major plus. Food & Lodging was wonderful as well as the gaming, The rooms were very clean with comfortable pillows and plenty of them .Will recommend this Resort /Casino to all .

reviews.title: Check it out
reviews.text: I have worked Vegas for 40Years . I have stayed everywhere. If you want a good deal with very nice restaurants and very reasonable rates try the Silverton. Great restaurants especilalat the steakhouse Twin Peaks. The pool isnice and your family willHave a good time especially if you are in a budget. Try it you won’tBe disappointed or go back. To strip and spend way more theYou need to.

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: We love staying at the Silverton. Always have a great time. A little far from other casinos but there is no need to leave. The food is good the room is comfortable and the casino is full of both old and new machines.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: My husband and I traveled there on 3/28-3/30/19 so that we could experience the Big Garage and antique sale. We are pickers that buy and sell on eBay. We were so impressed with the size of the sale and organization. I felt like a kid at a candy store. We shop at Swapmeet’s every weekend. It was worth the drive from San Diego. Everyone at sale was nice and courteous. It exceeded my expectations. Thank you and we will be back for this sale when scheduled.
