reviews.text: But the drink servers well one specifially was nasty I made sure I went out n bought my self a big gulp just not to deal w ther servers just nasty asked  me where the other play was cauz I ordered two coke soda pop

reviews.title: You're screwing it up.  Get off the path of the strip casinos.
reviews.text: Stop changing the things that set you apart from the big groups.  You will lose the most loyal of your base.  The deal at Ultimate HoldEm has changed to increase the house edge.  Cigarettes are just as expensive as the strip, and comps are less friendly.  The "new sheriff" is about to push out.  We booked at the Rio next trip. Knock it off!

reviews.title: Great All Around Place
reviews.text: The Silverton is just the right size.  Many of them are to large and you have to walk a mile just to get to your room. The restaurants are excellent as are the bars and casino.  The staff are friendly, outgoing and are always there to help in case you need something.  The rooms are comfortable and the location is great.

reviews.title: Bad Experieance
reviews.text: room as super noisy walls are paper thin you can hear the 15 freeway like it is 10 feet away.  The only thing good about this place is the Bass Proshop Which is a must see.  Go see the Bass Proshop but don't stay in the hotel

reviews.title: OK Place because of good staff
reviews.text: Stayed here for three nights on a biz trip primarily due to location.  It was quite easy (and free) to park there and the checkin was great.  Very friendly and professional person did the honors.  That turned out to be the standard for staff in the casino, the shops, etc.  My room was on the first floor, unusual for Vegas, and the hallways were not all that well lit.  The room itself was spacious and very clean.  My only gripe is the bathroom which while clean was very small and had no ventilation at all.  The little grid in the ceiling did nothing about toilet odor or shower steam.

reviews.title: Nice less smokey casino off the strip
reviews.text: I was having a hard time breathing with the dense smoke at MGM.  We met some friends here for dinner one night.  It was considerably less smokey.  The restaurant was fantastic and seeing the mermaid was very neat!

reviews.title: stay
reviews.text: Overall stay was great, just wish there were fans in the bathrooms.  Also, cafe service was way too slow. We love staying there, would be more convenient if we could walk around with our 1-year old but security pushed us long every time.

reviews.title: Get off the Strip and enjoy Vegas at the Silverton
reviews.text: The restaurants at the Silverton are awesome. The players club is generous and the rooms spacious and clean. And there's the Bass Pro Shop and the huge aquarium too. Great service and decent slot payouts.

reviews.title: We left thirty minutes after we checked-in.
reviews.text: The title of the review pretty much says it all. My husband and I had a three night reservation with the Silverton based on the recommendation of an older family member but we checked-out on the first night. We arrived around 10 PM and check-in went fine, but as we started walking towards our room I started to get a sinking feeling. The hallway on our floor was very dark and felt musty. When we walked into our room, my heart sank further. I've stayed at La Quintas that have nicer rooms. It felt very much like a budget hotel room that hadn't been updated within the last two decades. Everything was brown, beige, leather, and old. The deal breaker, however, was the mattress. The mattress had absolutely NO support. It was like a bag of marshmallows. My husband is a larger man and sleeping on a mattress like that would have definitely caused him to wake up in the morning with back pains, if he was able to sleep at all. I called down to the front desk to ask if they had rooms with a different kind of mattress. They do not. After a scramble online to find another hotel with rooms available, we made a reservation at The Flamingo on the Strip for almost exactly the same price we were paying to stay at the Silverton and checked out that same night. It was the BEST decision we made our entire trip. We had to eat the cost of one night at the Silverton, but even with that loss, we were practically giddy with relief when we checked into a hotel that was well lit, well maintained, and in a much nicer area of town. If you want absolutely no frills for about the same price that you would pay to stay somewhere much nicer, then the Silverton is for you, I guess, but otherwise I would look elsewhere.

reviews.title: Wonderful Stay as usual
reviews.text: We had a great stay as usual.  Lots of things to do, good restaurants, great Sportsbook and lots of free stuff for playing.  Only thing was the bed was way to soft and felt like sleeping on a water bed (which it was not).

reviews.title: Excellent Stay
reviews.text: Good stay at reasonable price and I just love it. I shall stay there again soon on another business trips and the food ay Wuhu was excellent and reasonable. The only set-back during the stay was that there was no microwave and small fridge. The staff had been kind and attentive and never had any discourteous services except that they forgot to email me the receipt and I had to call to request one.

reviews.title: Small Hotel, but Big VALUE
reviews.text: Nothing fancy about Silverton. Small hotel, that offers clean rooms, good food, good service, sport book area and lots of offering to their players. No faking, not trying to be something they not. Just a simple little hotel that treats you right.

reviews.title: Nice time in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Had a nice time Sliverton Hotel was great....pool was good....gym/workout area was small and outdated....but other than that and one rude front desk clerk having a bad week everything and everyone else was good.....

reviews.title: Well pleased with stay @ the Silverton
reviews.text: From the time we checked into our room, until the time we left, we were very happy. The lady @ the front desk  Belinda was so nice & helpful. The bell service was great valet were very nice & helpful as well. The staff were courteous  & knowledgeable,  definitely would stay again

reviews.title: continuing value
reviews.text: the staff and my casino host  continue to value me and my visits I will be returning in September 2019 with the confidence that I will be treated well. I have been coming to the Silverton for over six years, and look forward to returning.

reviews.title: Silverton Stay in Vegas
reviews.text: The most comfortable beds !!   Have stayed there many times......perfect every time.  Food service is exceptional!  Valet parking very courteous!   The whole experience is wonderful!  Twin Creeks restaurant is outstanding!

reviews.title: Silverton
reviews.text: Nice place, great restaurants.  Needs a little face-lift.  Staff is very friendly.  We enjoyed our stay.  The Silverton just needs a little sprucing up.  There's a shuttle to Aria 4 times a day which is very nice.

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: We loved the hotel, atmosphere, staff and food. We have stayed before with my dad. He is who recommended this hotel to us. We will definitely be back again. We are looking at returning in April or May.

reviews.title: Come to play and eat, not sleep
reviews.text: Overall, I loved the hotel. FYI, there are no refrigerators or coffee makers in the room. The walls are paper thin and you can hear EVERYTHING!! BUT the redeeming thing is the food. The restaurants ALL have fantastic food. Can't explain just how good it is. Bar was serving great drinks. I didn't win this time, but they do have a good variety of slots. Nice, relaxing place to be.

reviews.title: Improve the Nice Accommodations
reviews.text: Good casino with all the amenities you would need (food, beverages, gaming, close to airport).  Never felt I had to go to The Strip to have fun.  Would like to see continued improvement on the hotel rooms; otherwise, the staff was very professional and helpful to all questions.

reviews.title: Silverton is Special
reviews.text: Pleasant, polite and cordial staff.  Clean rooms in a comfortable setting.  Very fair slots and poker machines and an open casino floor offering a variety of gaming machines with various denominations.  The restrooms were always sparkling, service was friendly, gracious and helpful.  We enjoyed ourselves and our guests did also.  Thank you again Silverton for another wonderful Vegas experience.

reviews.title: Great Stay Again!
reviews.text: Great stay! Birthday trip, great free offers, bed very comfortable, shuttle, close to airport, good selection of restaurants, love the aquarium, quiet and clean, have stayed multiple times and will be back again!

reviews.title: Family Business
reviews.text: Me and my wife had some business to take care of in Las Vegas, I have always wanted to stay at the silverton. We had a really great time. The staff was excellent and being able to go to the bass pro shop was awesome. We will be staying here again.

reviews.title: Best Beds in LV!!!
reviews.text: Silverton is off the strip making it so peaceful and relaxing. Just minutes from the airport. Very clean with the most comfortable beds in Las Vegas!!! Great selection of tables games and slots that keep me coming back!!!

reviews.title: Quality of stay
reviews.text: All in all it was pretty good especially the free play and buffet.  Really would have been better with free comp rooms too.  Next time I come out to visit my family I would like to have the opportunity to spend time at the silverton instead of going down to the strip to gamble ,the silverton is not so fast paced you can really enjoy it.

reviews.title: Very pleased
reviews.text: First time staying with you, we're glad we did, we will return again soon, the stay was relaxing, we are non smokers and the gaming area wasn't full of smoke and ash trays were pretty much emptied  after use

reviews.title: Love the proximity to Bass Pro Shop
reviews.text: great place to stay and play single deck Blackjack was the best, had a great time in the slot tournament. We come up with family every year always have fun. Mi Casa mexican restaurant is fantastic.We look foward to coming back.

reviews.title: Shelby Bash
reviews.text: I've stayed at this location for several years now up until this year have had no issues and have been treated very well I don't know what happened this year but it just seems like the hotel property or management was not very receptive during our organization using them as our Host hotel

reviews.title: Fun Time
reviews.text: This was the second time staying at this hotel and I have gambled here many times.  I like it because the casino staff are so friendly and professional.  The dealers and cocktail waitresses are always pleasant.  The rooms are clean and the beds are comfy.  They don't charge for parking.  The Seasons Buffet is good along with Sundance Grill.

reviews.title: My Review
reviews.text: Complimentary midweek rooms were not complimentary! We were given a special rate that was reduced but we were under the assumption they were complimentary during midweek. The card we received in the mail was misleading!

reviews.title: Relaxing at Silverton
reviews.text: I dined at Mi Casa, Wuhu Noodle, Sundance Grill, and Twin Creek Steak House  were all a 5 star experience.  Service and food were exceptional, especially at Twin Creek. Adrian at check out was awesome. Steve in the footwear department of Bass Pro Shop treated me like I owned the place.  He sold me a very comfortable pair of hiking boots. A relaxing place to stay.🍸

reviews.title: Excellent hotel and casino.
reviews.text: Always enjoy our stay here.  Restaurants are excellent and casino is spacious and not smokey.  Employees are helpful and friendly.  Close to the airport and entertainment venues.  First time to try Johnny Rocket's hamburgers......excellent.

reviews.title: vacation
reviews.text: very nice place to stay. Not the best place to gamble .The rooms are nice the food is very good we have been staying at the Silverton  for years. We don't spend a lot of time in the room we go to gamble

reviews.title: Great Hotel and Great Experience
reviews.text: This was my second time staying at The Silverton and I was just as pleased as the first time. I originally chose because of its close proximity to the car rental return at the airport. I also like that it is located a ways away from the strip, but still very close. You fee like you are in your own world at The Silverton. I ordered room service and was pleasantly surprised by the huge portions, as well as the reasonable pricing. My room was spotless on arrival, and all hotel staff I came in contact with were very pleasant. I am taking my husband and kids with me next time, and I know they will love it.

reviews.title: Fantastic Stay
reviews.text: We had an incredible stay! You have the best beds & pillows. Had the best sleep ever! Food was excellent, especially Su Casa & Gilma who kept our room spotless & comfortable. The front desk staff were excellent, friendly & personable.

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: Silverton is nice, inexpensive if you want to stay for a few days and have access to a casino without being on the Strip.  Nice aquarium and restaurants also.  Casino is fun and has enough machines and was not too smoky.

reviews.title: Great Place to Stay!
reviews.text: Hotel is very Clean and well kept. Great stay for fun and casino enjoyment. Great stay for the family. Restaurants are delicious. Service could be better. Overall great place to and enjoy the Las Vegas experience.

reviews.title: Silverton Experience
reviews.text: Great place to stay off strip, machines are loose and just an overall great place to stay.Buffet has a variety to select from.  They make the best Pesto!  Polynesian night  - Don't pass that up on a Saturday night.

reviews.title: Little Gem in the Desert
reviews.text: Came to have some fun for the weekend. It was perfect!The staff is so helpful and nice.  From the moment you drive up at valet until you walk into your room, the staff is very welcoming!It's a perfect spot for that Vegas fix without the stress of staying at the busy strip.Just a great place!

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Room was drab. It's like they updated all the rooms but ours. Need a small fridge and coffee maker. Bed was horrible. Main issue was that bed. Lay down and your feet are higher than your head. Pillows were rock hard. Stayed here years ago and it was great. That's why we chose to come back.

reviews.title: How I enjoyed staying there
reviews.text: I did enjoy staying at your hotel it was very nice. Too many people it was a perfect Hotel to pick I would stay there again and recommend people to stay there and I enjoy my staying there it's very clean like my room like the restaurants that are there and the cleanness and I would really go back to stay there thank you for everything I really enjoyed staying there

reviews.title: Shining
reviews.text: First I would and will stay here again, however not in room 4048.  At end of long hallway and did not feel safe.  There is an exit door right next to room.  The room was spacious with couch for relaxing also TV was nice and large with tons of viewing options.  Which is nice if you don’t gamble. They have a 24 hour dining area with tons of options.  My server Stephanie was fast pleasant and came to check on my several times. I would recommend it’s a nice hotel with friendly staff.

reviews.title: A Great Experience!
reviews.text: Great friendly staff in all areas of the Silverton.  Room was comfortable and clean.  The food at the Sundance is excellent - really enjoy their breakfast.  Easy access from the freeway. Very nice parking garage. Wonderful service at the front desk.  Everything was smoothly completed from check in to check out.  Am looking forward to returning.  A very nice and pleasant experiene. A++++

reviews.title: Hotel experience
reviews.text: This is a great hotel to stay at if you like to be able to open your windows. I love to have fresh air at night when I sleep. Also for sports and clothing shopping with the Bass Pro Shop attached. The aquarium is very beautiful to sit and which! The casino is not too big which makes it more personable.

reviews.title: Cozy and chill place
reviews.text: We've been coming here for years because of the chill and laid back atmosphere. It's also more affordable than strip location hotels but still a nearby 10 min drive. Only bummer is, there are not a lot of food choices to select from. The Mexican restaurant is a bit overpriced and closes early at 9. The cafe menu needs to updated to included better more relevant options. The Gelato Counter is great, when it's open. They shut down 1 day a week for cleaning, but don't know what day and it really should be done in the early am so that we may enjoy gelato at more times of the day. The Buffet is just ok, it used to be good but it seems they've gotten a bit basic and cheap. Johnny Rockets does not impress me, nor does the Wu Noodles place. Starbucks speaks for itself, but prices are a bit inflated. Would love if they would update their look & dining options, bring some excitement and newness into the place. The employees are great, friendly and helpful.. Overall the atmosphere is great! If you wanna chill with no craziness, bring your peeps down for the table games, they are always poppin with life!

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.text: Always stay at the Silverton when I’m in Las Vegas. I’ve been staying here for years and will never stay anyplace else. I never have any complaints and if there is something that needs to be addressed, it’s done fast efficient and correct. Thanks you Silverton for a another perfect stay! 😊

reviews.title: Best comfortable hotel
reviews.text: Best stay. Once again Silverton excels at what they do. Staff is always welcoming and helpful. We were there for a proposal and they took care of us. Arnold, Lori and Katie were the best. We were lucky enough to get a last minute room and they did everything possible to make it as comfortable as they could. In the end everything worked out and it was the best.

reviews.title: Great hotel@
reviews.text: Great staff! Very friendly! We have stayed there a few years and love it! We would recommend it to all our friends and family! The hotel and rooms are very clean and quiet! It's nice and close to some great restaurants and shopping.

reviews.title: Family reunion
reviews.text: It is hard for all of us to get together cause of work, etc. therefore being at Silverton made it veryspecial.  we have been staying here many times each year. thank you for taking care of us.the YFI is a little slow. ( the only negative thing)

reviews.title: Room needed serious TLC
reviews.text: Our room had holes in the carpet and looked pretty rough. The cafe in the casing was great. The food was good and not overly expensive. Our bed was uncomfortable & noisy.  And the room needed to be totally updated.

reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: Excellent service & great value for your money! Great location, near my mom’s apartment. Close to the strip without the traffic. No parking fees is a plus! Love Seasons buffet! Even when we don’t stay in the hotel, we always got to seasons! Great selection of food.

reviews.title: Poor experience.
reviews.text: The rooms are overpriced for condition and need update. Resort fee is merely a hidden way to increase price for commonplace amenities. Desk staff was dismissive over disagreement regarding resort fee, not even offering to ask management, if anything could be done. Will not go back.

reviews.title: Very Disappointing
reviews.text: Run down room. Room need to some TLC. Foot of bed was higher than the head of bed. We have stayed at the Silverton over the years. We went back because we new we would be getting good service, reasonable prices, off the strip and next to the Pro Bass Shop. Wow this trip was very disappointing.

reviews.title: Rooms need refurbishing!
reviews.text: Please train the front desk not to lie about the amenities just to get guest to stay there!Need to put coffee makers and makeup mirrors in the rooms. Updating and repairs needed in rooms.Heat the outdoor pool please.

reviews.title: My favorite place to stay in Vegas
reviews.text: I was originally introduced to the Silverton by a friend many years ago who lived close by. I began staying here before it was remodeled to its current state and before they built the adjoining Bass Pro Shop. I have always loved staying here and have brought many friends & family with me. Everyone I bring loves it as well. From the staff to the rooms to the atmosphere, the Silverton is a great value in Vegas. I prefer to stay off the strip yet if I want to go to the strip, it’s just a short ride to get there. I highly recommend staying at the Silverton!

reviews.title: Silverton Hotel and Casino visit Feb 2019
reviews.text: Nice hotel in a good location. Friendly staff. Good casino. Our bed was very comfortable. We enjoyed Twin Creeks steak house, our meal was excellent.  Seasons buffet was well kept and had a good variety.  Shuttle for hotel guests to/from the airport and the strip was convenient.  Will visit again.

reviews.title: Enjoyable and Crazy
reviews.text: Enjoyed the first two days of our visit. Room was clean and comfortable, the food was great, the folks at check in where vary helpful. Day three not so good. The hotel lost power around 10am till 6pm at no fault off Silverton hotel & casino. To make a long story short there was no way to shower, all the restaurants where closed, couldn't play the slots and had to get a Uber to take us to a restaurant for dinner. Other than that third day we enjoyed our visit and look forward to our next visit.

reviews.title: Good value.
reviews.text: The rooms are spacious and clean. Beds comfortable. The reception staff are friendly. The Free parking. A good players club reward program. The Sundance Grill is great value and staff are good. A free shuttle bus runs to the strip and airportI.  I love the fact it adjoins Bass Pro Shop.

reviews.title: Silverton Hotel/Casino
reviews.text: Pleasant atmosphere. Excellent food. Very good gambling. Convenient location near freeway, but not in the congestion of the Strip. Easy check-in and check-out. Staff friendly and readily available. Quiet, clean rooms although not a lot of amenities.

reviews.title: Inconvenience not addressed
reviews.text: Orher than the power outage inconvenience not being addressed,our stay was pleasing. Staff, outside of the registration manager, were very nice and I liked that people were walking around passing out water when everything was closed.

reviews.title: February Stay
reviews.text: Great place to stay if the power does not go out. I have stayed at Silverton many time I think I'ts a great place to stay love all of the dealers and pit bosses front desk are all great. But Feed guest when power go's out.

reviews.title: Always a Great Time!
reviews.text: This is a well kept secret where mostly locals tend to frequent. The rooms are simple but clean and the beds are fantastic. Nose is very minimal and the staff is well trained, courteous and helpful. If you would like to visit Vegas on a budget you can't go wrong at the Silverton.

reviews.title: Stay with ease
reviews.text: I love the Silverton.  We (My family & friends) have been coming for multiple years and love the convenience of the hotel/casino, location, cleanliness, hospitality and most of all the staff.  We have not had a bad experience at all.  One time we checked out left our jacket behind and informed the staff and they wasted no time in retrieving it for us.

reviews.title: very professional
reviews.text: The silverton has one of the best front desk agents.  sorry I did not get his name when we checked in but he was very friendly and professional.  When we checked out, he was at the counter along with a hawaiian girl and I received the same or even better experience.  It was my birthday and they wished me a happy birthday.  In hawaiii we greet everyone as uncle and aunty.  She addressed me as uncle and told me happy birthday.THE BEST STAFF EXPERIENCE EVER.....

reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: This is a great hotel for the casino and the hotel. There is a cracker barrel in the parking lot of the facilty and their Casino is pretty good. Their mermaid show is entertaining and they have free parking. They have shuttles to and from the strip. I love the Silverton and will continue to stay here.

reviews.title: Best casino/hotel
reviews.text: Staff is great.Rooms are a bit dated but kept spotless by housekeeping staffPrices are goodCasino floor is not as loud and crowded as many of the strip locationsI come to Vegas most every February and Silverton is my first choice to stay

reviews.title: Just ok this time
reviews.text: I have had much better stays.  Disappointed in the guest service.  Staff was not very helpful in a problem that arose.  Guests were left to fend for themselves.  No help with somewhere to eat no water offered.

reviews.title: 2 night stay
reviews.text: Will stay again, the only problem we had was poor service in restaurant.  We did breakfast and dinner in the same restaurant and service was poor both times.  The food was good.  Where in town for a NAPA convention.  Photography seminar.

reviews.title: Viva Silverton.
reviews.text: Have been there three times so far. Good experience each time. Free parking and the next door Bass Pro Shops are a plus for me. A small casino where the dealers keep their tips. I wish a particular dealer would not talk politics while I am having fun loosing money.

reviews.title: Weekend Vegas Trip
reviews.text: Vegas Weekend.  The closest entrance near the hotel elevator is a little wonky and hard to find.  Long walk to the room.  No coffee maker but quick room service.  We would stay again as the price was right.

reviews.title: Changes going bad.
reviews.text: I'm not sure if there are management changes happening with Silverton, but it is showing in the changes in their shortcuts.  The rooms are not as comfortable as in the past with the beds.  I use to love the comfort of their mattresses after a long day of gaming and sightseeing but it seems as though Silverton has changed their mattresses to ridiculously lumpy uncomfortable mattresses. Silverton has always been my first choice of hotel in Las Vegas because of its many great amenities but if management is going to start making cuts around comfort and the staff, I will be looking to other places for my stay.

reviews.title: love the silverton
reviews.text: we enjoy staying at the Silverton it's away from all the hustle and bustle, everyone is super nice and accommodating plus I always come home with money, we go there every year for my husbands birthday, it's a plus for him that the bass pro shop is right there. will be back next year.

reviews.title: Decent hotel away from the strip mania
reviews.text: The Silverton hotel is very adaquate. It is a nice place, but be aware that you do not get a microwave, coffee pot, nor refrigerator in your room.  The room was clean and supply of linens etc. was satisfactory. No frills, and there is a $20 resort fee tackled onto the room. We use it for a stop over before and after the airport. We don’t use the casino and like that we don’t have to go near the strip. We found the buffet in the casino to be excellent for both breakfast and dinner.

reviews.title: Avoid the strip and just enjoy a great local property.
reviews.text: Silverton is my first choice for any Vegas trip.  Have been traveling to Vegas for 40+ years and this property just gets it right!  Friendly, great service and comfortable accommodations.  One of the best rewards programs in Vegas for out of town visitors and locals.  Pay attention to the days where point values are increased, weekday visits.  Reservations are a good idea if you want a great steak dinner at Twin Creeks on Friday or Saturday nights.

reviews.title: Satisfied
reviews.text: Pretty much as expected and was what I needed.  Staff and facility good to very good, but not exceptional.  Hotel is actually hard to find if you haven't been there before as its entrance is buried in the casino.  Rooms are clean, quiet and OK.  No coffee in room.  I was there only for one night as it was a place to stay so I could catch an outbound flight fairly early the next morning.  Am not a gambler.

reviews.title: Our stay at Silverton
reviews.text: We have been staying at Silverton since 2011. We discovered it when our son started attending UNLV. We visited often and at the time we found the Silverton to have reasonable rates, wonderful rooms, helpful and friendly staff, location from the strip, food choices, shopping opportunities in Outdoor World which it is connected to, and the buffet where we had a couple of events. Love the Silverton!!

reviews.title: Great Customer Service
reviews.text: Valet, Bell Desk, Front Desk, Housekeeping, Dealers, Cocktails, Restaurant Staff, Buffet Staff, every employee we interacted with was great. Friendly and helpful and most of all made us feel appreciated for being at their property.

reviews.title: Stomping overhead
reviews.text: If staying at this property I highly recommend you get a top floor room or hope the person above you is respectful. Mine were not they stomped on the floor all night. I got no sleep was very miserable.

reviews.title: Relaxation & great food. The machines pay also!
reviews.text: We will be back in May for our anniversary and my husbands bday. We cant wait. Everyone we bring with us has had the same wonderful experiences as we have. They are also hooked on Silverton. We LOVE the Bass Pro Shop! Great close & great all-round experience inside.

reviews.title: Nice Digs Off Strip
reviews.text: We stop by here almost every time we're in Las Vegas.  We have also stayed here.  The "Free" Mermaid show is a must.  Great photo op!  The Bass Pro Shop is also something you should venture into.Check-in was fast, when we stayed.  No complaints about the room & the pool was great.  Self Parking was still free, when we were there last.  Free Parking is fast become extinct in Vegas.

reviews.title: Excellent Secret
reviews.text: Silverton is a gem among Goliaths. Beds/bedding is awesome, rooms are very functional and spacious. Great selection of food choices at reasonable prices. Parking is easy. Staff is friendly and truly appreciate your staying there. Will definitely continue to use this property when staying in Vegas.

reviews.title: Easy access, no mile long walk to your room, great breakfast at the Sundance
reviews.text: I have been here twice for business and I really appreciate the location, easy parking and it's a short walk from my car to my room.  The on property Starbucks is a nice perk and the breakfast at Sundance is better than most table service breakfasts I have had.  I'm not a gambler but the casino floor was clean and well laid out.  The staff was always friendly and I enjoyed the aquarium while I waited for my other people to arrive downstairs.

reviews.title: My stay at the Silverton
reviews.text: Great deals, nice rooms, excellent rewards program, plenty of gambling, excellent restaurants, helpful lobby, clean throughout. Near the Las Vegas strip and the airport. Plenty to do twenty four hours a day. I would definitely recommend this hotel casino.

reviews.title: Stay while waiting to pick up at trade show
reviews.text: Very good place to stay. Although we thought parking a semi truck would be accommodated. We did spend quite a bit more than any winnings at casino. Restaurants were good. Twin Creeks was excellent!will definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: silverton hotel and Casino
reviews.text: Wonderful stay as always.  Love the staff and the pillows, too.  Always have a nice meal.  Love the house coffee especially.  Not crowded with 20 year-olds.  We are locals so we enjoy being off the strip.  Thank you Lori at the front desk and Marguerite the housekeeper.  Great work.

reviews.title: First time at Silverton
reviews.text: If your looking for a hotel/casino off the strip with more to offer, stay at the Silverton.  They have a good variety of restaurants to choose from, and having the Bass Pro Shop connected was a huge plus!

reviews.title: Great price but the rooms aren't great
reviews.text: The bed is comfy, the price is amazing. Realize you are off of the strip. The mermaids are super fun. Just the overall quality has gone down hill. I've stayed here three times now, due to it's easy access to Blue Diamond and the trails. And it's an easy 10 min drive over to the strip. But the downsize: bathroom wasn't very clean and didn't drain properly, the hallway carpet is getting very worn, and the overall quality was weak. Probably choosing a different deal next time.

reviews.title: Great place and location!
reviews.text: We stayed one night as we were headed to Utah. This place did not disappoint! Very nice décor, clean rooms. Staff was very nice and helpful. They have lots of restaurants with different menus and prices. Hubby loved that it was connected to Bass Pro Shop!

reviews.title: A good time was had by all.
reviews.text: We came because the promotional offers were outstanding. Then that didn’t matter as much as the fun and relaxing time we had. The slot machines were fair. Not always easy but fair. The meals were good. The place was relaxed. Few hassles.

reviews.title: Relaxing place to gamble and vacation
reviews.text: The Silverton is a great hotel and casino. The rooms are nice. The staff and dealers are friendly. My spot when I visit Vegas. They have a great Buffett and Mexican restaurant as well. The location is perfect !

reviews.title: Great!
reviews.text: Everything was wonderful. Mermaid bar has the best bloody Mary’s & we tried the food for the first time & it was yummy! The rooms were super clean, and beds super comphy!!!! My family was very happy with the choice of hotel/casino! We are not strip people, but still enjoy the casino atmosphere!

reviews.title: One and Done
reviews.text: Room had a bad smell in it. Definitely needs updating as everything besides the bed and the TV appear to be quite old. You can tell the cleaning staff only do a quick surface clean in the rooms as a closer look at anything reveals dirt, dust, grime and stains. Check in and check out were quick and painless. We were only there one night and will not return unless there is a remodel or update to everything in the room.

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Staff was ultra friendly, food at the buffet and Sundance Grill was wonderful and priced reasonably. Lots of slots to choose from. Location is close to outlet mall and any restaurant you ca think of including a Cracker Barrel!

reviews.title: SERVICE
reviews.text: The Silverton made our trip a success!  Went there for a family wedding.  It was fantastic!  Everything was great!  Arnold at the front desk was very nice and helpful.  We would definitely go there again.  Thank you!!

reviews.title: Vegas get away!
reviews.text: Hotel was clean and the bed was very comfortable! SAtaff was friendly and helpfull. The table limits are very low and slot machines seem to pay a little. The resteraunts had out standing food and good prices.the buffet resteraunt had a good selection and the food was ok.

reviews.title: I love the Silverton Hotel & Casino
reviews.text: It’s a Vegas experience w/o the traffic & drama of the strip. Having the Bass Pro Shop & 2 Starbucks close by is also a plus. The staff is always so welcoming & friendly. Also this casino has the big tank which is awesome to see the mermaids.

reviews.title: Average
reviews.text: I will stay again but I will not gamble inside the hotel and I will not book another room for smoking a few of the card dealers I have was very rude and smart mouth because they were tired and was ready to go home  they was not a respectable person

reviews.title: MY ESCAPE FROM EVERYDAY LIFE
reviews.text: Overall, it was a very nice stay. Check-in was pleasant and quick. We were pleased that we were able to keep the same room even though it was under two different names, and  dates. The room was clean and quiet. I felt comfortable going back and forth from the Casino/restaurants to the room by myself.The food selection in the Buffet was excellent and surprisingly quite good. Only complaint would be that I wasn't able to stay longer.

reviews.title: mini vacation
reviews.text: Nice place to stay and I would recommend it to others. They have the games I like to play. I was also appreciative that they gave me an extra complimentary night and was moved up to platinum level. Thanks .

reviews.title: My Opinion
reviews.text: Could be updated and cleaner......Sorry!  I don't know what else to say as I answered your questions in the survey. When I first went to get money through my checking account the girl wasn't very informed.  She told me that I was not eligible to get any as there was none available.  I missed going to Vegas last year as I had open heart surgery and had to cancel so I wasn't in you system and when I went to the cashier I hadn't gambled yet.  Subsequently I did qualify but she didn't explain.
